source.text: Τολμᾷ τις ὑμῶν πρᾶγμα ἔχων πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον κρίνεσθαι ἐπὶ τῶν ἀδίκων, καὶ οὐχὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ἁγίων;

records.literal_gloss: Dares anyone of you a matter having against the other to be judged before the unrighteous, and not before the holy [ones]?

en.L: Does any of you, having a matter against another, dare to go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the holy ones?
en.B: When one of you has a dispute with another, how can you dare to take it to court before the unrighteous instead of before God's holy people?
en.R: Suppose one of you has a complaint against another believer. How can you dare to take it to a court where unbelievers are the judges? Why not bring it to God's people instead?

fr.L: Quelqu’un de vous, ayant une affaire contre un autre, ose-t-il aller en justice devant les injustes, et non devant les saints ?
fr.B: Quand l’un de vous a un différend avec un autre, comment ose-t-il porter l’affaire devant le tribunal des injustes plutôt que devant le peuple saint de Dieu ?
fr.R: Imaginons que l’un de vous ait une plainte contre un autre croyant. Comment ose-t-il aller devant un tribunal où les juges sont des incroyants ? Pourquoi ne pas porter l’affaire devant le peuple de Dieu ?

es.L: ¿Se atreve alguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, teniendo un pleito contra otro, a ir a juicio ante los injustos, y no ante los santos?
es.B: Cuando uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tiene un conflicto con otro, ¿cómo se atreve a llevarlo a los tribunales ante los injustos, en lugar de llevarlo ante el pueblo santo de Dios?
es.R: Supongamos que uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tiene una queja contra otro creyente. ¿Cómo se atreve a llevarla a un tribunal donde los jueces no son creyentes? ¿Por qué no la lleva más bien al pueblo de Dios?

sw.L: Je, yupo mmoja wenu ambaye, akiwa na kesi dhidi ya mwingine, anathubutu kuhukumiwa mbele ya wasio waadilifu, badala ya mbele ya watakatifu?
sw.B: Mmoja wenu akiwa na mzozo na mwenzake, anawezaje kuthubutu kuupeleka mahakamani mbele ya wasio waadilifu badala ya mbele ya watu watakatifu wa Mungu?
sw.R: Tuseme mmoja wenu ana malalamiko dhidi ya mwamini mwenzake. Anawezaje kuthubutu kuyapeleka kwenye mahakama ambako wasioamini ndio mahakimu? Kwa nini asiyalete kwa watu wa Mungu badala yake?

vi.L: Có ai trong anh chị em, khi có việc tranh chấp với người khác, lại dám đi kiện trước mặt những kẻ bất chính, mà không [đi] trước mặt các thánh đồ sao?
vi.B: Khi một người trong anh chị em có việc tranh chấp với người khác, sao lại dám đưa nhau ra tòa trước mặt những người bất chính, thay vì trước mặt dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời?
vi.R: Giả sử một người trong anh chị em có điều bất bình với một tín hữu khác. Sao anh chị em lại dám đem việc ấy ra một tòa án do những người không tin Chúa xét xử? Sao không đem việc ấy đến với dân của Đức Chúa Trời?

ko.L: 여러분 가운데 누가 다른 사람과 소송할 일이 있을 때, 감히 불의한 사람들 앞에서 재판을 받고 성도들 앞에서는 받지 않습니까?
ko.B: 여러분 가운데 누가 다른 사람과 다툴 일이 있을 때, 어떻게 감히 성도들 앞에 가져가지 않고 불의한 사람들 앞에서 재판을 받으려고 합니까?
ko.R: 여러분 가운데 누가 다른 신자에게 불만이 있다고 합시다. 어떻게 감히 그 일을 믿지 않는 사람들이 재판관으로 있는 법정에 가져갈 수 있습니까? 왜 하나님의 백성에게 가져가지 않습니까?

decisions.choice: a lawsuit over a civil matter, brought before the city's courts
decisions.reason: πρᾶγμα was used of a legal case, and κρίνεσθαι of going to law or having one's case decided. Corinth was a Roman colony, and civil cases were heard before its magistrates. Verses 4 and 7-8 show that the cases were about property and money, matters of everyday life.

decisions.choice: the unrighteous: people outside God's people, here the judges of the city's courts
alternatives: judges who were corrupt or took bribes
decisions.reason: ἀδίκων is set against ἁγίων; ("the holy ones"), and verse 6 calls the same people ἀπίστων; ("unbelievers"). Paul describes their standing before God, not their honesty as judges. The word prepares for verse 9, where the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God, and verse 8, where the believers themselves do wrong.

decisions.choice: the holy ones: the believers, the people God has set apart as his own
alternatives: especially holy members of the church
decisions.reason: As in 1:2, the holy ones are the whole church, called to belong to God. Paul is asking why the church does not settle the matter within itself.

decisions.choice: dare: an indignant question, asking how anyone can bring himself to do this
decisions.reason: Τολμᾷ stands first for emphasis. Paul is not asking for information; he is shocked that a believer would do such a thing.

decisions.choice: go to law (L); take it to court (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb means having one's case decided by a court; English says this with "go to law" or "take to court".

decisions.choice: holy ones (L); God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: As in Philippians and Colossians: "saints" now suggests especially good people, but Paul means every believer.

decisions.choice: another believer; a court where unbelievers are the judges
decisions.reason: Readable says who the parties and the judges are (m2), and splits the question in two.

decisions.choice: les saints (L); le peuple saint de Dieu (B); le peuple de Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for this term and as Colossians does: "les saints" today suggests especially holy people, but Paul means every believer.

decisions.choice: les injustes (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Injustes" keeps the word that returns in 6:7-9 ("subir l’injustice", "commettre l’injustice", "les injustes"), so the reader can follow Paul's play on it, as the English does with "unrighteous" and "wrong". Readable names them as unbelievers (m2).

decisions.choice: los santos (L); el pueblo santo de Dios (B); el pueblo de Dios (R)
decisions.reason: As in Philippians 4:21: Literal keeps "santos"; Balanced and Readable say whose people they are, because "los santos" alone is often heard in Spanish as canonized saints. The same in verse 2.

decisions.choice: ¿cómo se atreve ...? (third person)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable turn to "you". Spanish keeps the Greek "anyone of you ... dare" in the third person, which is just as natural and keeps the indignant question (m4).

decisions.choice: watakatifu (L); watu watakatifu wa Mungu (B); watu wa Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: The settled New Testament forms for the holy ones, as in 1:2, so that Readable does not suggest saints in the later sense.

decisions.choice: "những kẻ bất chính" (L), "những người bất chính" (B), "những người không tin Chúa" (R) for the unrighteous; "đi kiện" (L), "đưa nhau ra tòa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Bất chính" is the word of the Vietnamese Romans 1:18 for adikia; Readable says who they are, the judges outside the church (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "성도" (L, B); "하나님의 백성" (R), here and in verse 2
decisions.reason: "성도" at Literal and Balanced, as the Korean Romans, Colossians and the other letters of Paul have it; Readable says "하나님의 백성".

source.text: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ ἅγιοι τὸν κόσμον κρινοῦσιν;

records.literal_gloss: Or not do you know that the holy [ones] the world will judge?

en.L: Or do you not know that the holy ones will judge the world?
en.B: Or do you not know that God's holy people will judge the world?
en.R: Do you not know that God's people will judge the world?

fr.L: Ou ne savez-vous pas que les saints jugeront le monde ?
fr.B: Ou ne savez-vous pas que le peuple saint de Dieu jugera le monde ?
fr.R: Ne savez-vous pas que le peuple de Dieu jugera le monde ?

es.L: ¿O no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que los santos juzgarán al mundo?
es.B: ¿O no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que el pueblo santo de Dios juzgará al mundo?
es.R: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que el pueblo de Dios juzgará al mundo?

sw.L: Au hamfahamu kwamba watakatifu ndio watakaouhukumu ulimwengu?
sw.B: Au hamjui kwamba watu watakatifu wa Mungu watauhukumu ulimwengu?
sw.R: Je, hamjui kwamba watu wa Mungu watauhukumu ulimwengu?

vi.L: Hay anh chị em không biết rằng các thánh đồ sẽ xét xử thế gian sao?
vi.B: Hay anh chị em không biết rằng dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời sẽ xét xử thế gian sao?
vi.R: Anh chị em không biết rằng dân của Đức Chúa Trời sẽ xét xử thế gian sao?

ko.L: 아니면 성도들이 세상을 심판할 것을 알지 못합니까?
ko.B: 아니면 성도들이 세상을 심판하리라는 것을 알지 못합니까?
ko.R: 하나님의 백성이 세상을 심판할 것이라는 사실을 알지 못합니까?

decisions.choice: do you not know: a rebuke; they should know this
decisions.reason: Paul uses this question six times in this chapter (verses 2, 3, 9, 15, 16, 19), as in 3:16, each time reminding them of something they already know but are not living by.

decisions.choice: God's people will share in judging the world at the end
alternatives: their way of life will show up the world's wrong by contrast
decisions.reason: Scripture speaks of the holy ones receiving judgment and the kingdom (Daniel 7:22, 27), of the twelve judging the tribes of Israel (Matthew 19:28), and of thrones of judgment given to the faithful (Revelation 20:4). Paul assumes the Corinthians know this teaching.

decisions.choice: the world: humankind apart from God, which will face his judgment
decisions.reason: κόσμον here means people, the world that God judges (11:32; Romans 3:6).

decisions.choice: holy ones (L); God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

decisions.choice: "심판하다" for judging the world and angels; "재판하다" for the lawsuits; "판단하다" for weighing a matter
decisions.reason: The Greek verb covers all three, but Korean words are narrower: "심판" for the last judgment (as in Romans), "재판" for a court case, "판단" for an assessment.

source.text: καὶ εἰ ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος, ἀνάξιοί ἐστε κριτηρίων ἐλαχίστων;

records.literal_gloss: And if by you is judged the world, unworthy are you of cases very small?

en.L: And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy of [judging] the smallest cases?
en.B: And if the world is to be judged by you, are you not fit to settle the most trivial of cases?
en.R: If you are going to judge the world, surely you can settle small problems like these?

fr.L: Et si c’est par vous que le monde est jugé, êtes-vous indignes de [juger] les plus petites affaires ?
fr.B: Et si le monde doit être jugé par vous, seriez-vous incapables de régler les affaires les plus insignifiantes ?
fr.R: Si vous allez juger le monde, vous êtes sûrement capables de régler de petits problèmes comme ceux-là !

es.L: Y si el mundo es juzgado por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ¿{{plural_you:son|sois}} indignos de [juzgar] los casos más pequeños?
es.B: Y si el mundo ha de ser juzgado por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ¿no {{plural_you:son|sois}} capaces de resolver los casos más insignificantes?
es.R: Si {{plural_you:van|vais}} a juzgar al mundo, ¿no {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} resolver problemas pequeños como estos?

sw.L: Na kama ulimwengu unahukumiwa kwenu, je, ninyi hamfai [kushughulikia] kesi ndogo kabisa?
sw.B: Na ikiwa ulimwengu utahukumiwa na ninyi, je, hamfai kuamua hata kesi ndogo kabisa?
sw.R: Ikiwa mtauhukumu ulimwengu, je, hamwezi kumaliza matatizo madogo kama haya?

vi.L: Và nếu thế gian bị anh chị em xét xử, thì anh chị em không đáng [xét xử] những vụ việc nhỏ nhặt nhất sao?
vi.B: Và nếu thế gian sẽ bị anh chị em xét xử, chẳng lẽ anh chị em lại không đủ khả năng phân xử những vụ việc nhỏ nhặt nhất sao?
vi.R: Nếu anh chị em sẽ xét xử thế gian, thì chắc chắn anh chị em có thể giải quyết những việc nhỏ như thế này chứ?

ko.L: 그리고 세상이 여러분에게 심판을 받는다면, 여러분은 아주 작은 사건들도 [재판할] 자격이 없습니까?
ko.B: 세상이 여러분에게 심판을 받을 것이라면, 여러분이 아주 사소한 사건들을 해결할 자격이 없겠습니까?
ko.R: 여러분이 세상을 심판할 것이라면, 이런 작은 문제쯤은 분명히 해결할 수 있지 않겠습니까?

decisions.choice: by you: the holy ones are the ones who judge
decisions.reason: ἐν ὑμῖν with a passive verb most naturally names who does the judging, which follows from verse 2a. Read as "before your court", the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: cases: the disputes being brought to court
alternatives: courts, the places where judgment is given
decisions.reason: κριτηρίων can mean a court (James 2:6) or a case heard in one. With "smallest" the point is the cases themselves: if they will judge the world, these disputes are nothing.

decisions.choice: unworthy: not competent, not fit for a task
decisions.reason: ἀνάξιοί means lacking the standing or the ability for something. The question expects the answer that they are fully able.

decisions.choice: [judging] (L); fit to settle (B); can settle (R)
decisions.reason: English needs a verb to say what they are fit for.

source.text: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἀγγέλους κρινοῦμεν, μήτιγε βιωτικά;

records.literal_gloss: Not do you know that angels we will judge, not to speak of things of this life?

en.L: Do you not know that we will judge angels, not to mention matters of this life?
en.B: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more, then, the affairs of everyday life!
en.R: Do you not know that we will judge angels? Then surely we can judge the ordinary problems of this life!

fr.L: Ne savez-vous pas que nous jugerons des anges, sans parler des affaires de cette vie ?
fr.B: Ne savez-vous pas que nous jugerons des anges ? À plus forte raison les affaires de la vie de tous les jours !
fr.R: Ne savez-vous pas que nous jugerons des anges ? Alors nous pouvons sûrement juger les problèmes ordinaires de cette vie !

es.L: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que juzgaremos a ángeles, por no hablar de los asuntos de esta vida?
es.B: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que juzgaremos a los ángeles? ¡Cuánto más los asuntos de la vida diaria!
es.R: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que juzgaremos a los ángeles? ¡Entonces con más razón podemos juzgar los problemas comunes de esta vida!

sw.L: Je, hamjui kwamba tutawahukumu malaika, achilia mbali mambo ya maisha haya?
sw.B: Je, hamjui kwamba tutawahukumu malaika? Si zaidi sana mambo ya maisha ya kila siku!
sw.R: Je, hamjui kwamba tutawahukumu malaika? Basi hakika tunaweza kuhukumu matatizo ya kawaida ya maisha haya!

vi.L: Anh chị em không biết rằng chúng ta sẽ xét xử các thiên sứ sao, huống chi là những việc của đời sống này?
vi.B: Anh chị em không biết rằng chúng ta sẽ xét xử các thiên sứ sao? Huống chi là những việc thường ngày của cuộc sống!
vi.R: Anh chị em không biết rằng chúng ta sẽ xét xử các thiên sứ sao? Thế thì chắc chắn chúng ta có thể xét xử những việc bình thường của cuộc sống này!

ko.L: 우리가 천사들을 심판할 것을 알지 못합니까? 하물며 이 세상 일들이야 [더 말할 것이 있겠습니까]?
ko.B: 우리가 천사들을 심판하리라는 것을 알지 못합니까? 그렇다면 일상생활의 일들은 더 말할 것도 없습니다!
ko.R: 우리가 천사들을 심판할 것이라는 사실을 알지 못합니까? 그렇다면 이 세상의 평범한 문제들은 분명히 우리가 판단할 수 있습니다!

decisions.choice: angels: most likely the angels who rebelled against God
alternatives: rulers thought to stand behind the nations
decisions.reason: Scripture speaks of angels who sinned and are kept for judgment (2 Peter 2:4; Jude 6). Paul does not say which angels; his point is that God's people will share in judgment on the highest level.

decisions.choice: not to mention: an argument from the greater to the lesser
decisions.reason: μήτιγε means "let alone" or "how much more": if they will judge angels, they can surely deal with everyday disputes.

decisions.choice: matters of this life: ordinary affairs such as money and property
decisions.reason: βιωτικά; describes what belongs to daily living, the business of this present life, as against the age to come.

decisions.choice: a second sentence
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the conclusion as a separate exclamation so that the argument from greater to lesser is clear (m2).

source.text: βιωτικὰ μὲν οὖν κριτήρια ἐὰν ἔχητε, τοὺς ἐξουθενημένους ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ, τούτους καθίζετε;

records.literal_gloss: Matters of this life indeed then if cases you have, those being despised in the church, these do you seat?

en.L: So if you have cases about matters of this life, do you seat as judges those who are of no account in the church?
en.B: So if you have cases about everyday matters, why do you seat as judges people who count for nothing in the church?
en.R: So when you have disputes about everyday things, why do you choose judges who have no standing at all in the church?

fr.L: Si donc vous avez des procès pour les affaires de cette vie, ceux qui ne comptent pour rien dans l’église, ceux-là, vous [les] faites siéger [comme juges] ?
fr.B: Si donc vous avez des procès pour des affaires de la vie courante, pourquoi faites-vous siéger comme juges des gens qui ne comptent pour rien dans l’église ?
fr.R: Alors, quand vous avez des désaccords sur des choses de tous les jours, pourquoi choisissez-vous des juges qui ne comptent pas du tout dans l’église ?

es.L: Así que, si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} pleitos sobre asuntos de esta vida, ¿a los que son tenidos en nada en la iglesia, a esos {{plural_you:ponen|ponéis}} [como jueces]?
es.B: Así que, si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} pleitos sobre asuntos de la vida diaria, ¿por qué {{plural_you:ponen|ponéis}} como jueces a personas que no cuentan para nada en la iglesia?
es.R: Así que, cuando {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} conflictos por cosas de todos los días, ¿por qué {{plural_you:escogen|escogéis}} como jueces a personas que no tienen ninguna autoridad en la iglesia?

sw.L: Basi, mkiwa na kesi za mambo ya maisha haya, je, mnawaketisha [kama mahakimu] wale wasiohesabiwa kitu katika kanisa?
sw.B: Basi mnapokuwa na kesi kuhusu mambo ya kila siku, kwa nini mnawaweka kuwa mahakimu watu wasio na hadhi yoyote katika kanisa?
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mnapokuwa na mizozo kuhusu mambo ya kila siku, kwa nini mnachagua mahakimu ambao hawana nafasi yoyote katika kanisa?

vi.L: Vậy nếu anh chị em có những vụ việc về đời sống này, anh chị em lại đặt những người bị xem thường trong Hội Thánh [làm quan xét] sao?
vi.B: Vậy nếu anh chị em có những vụ việc về đời sống thường ngày, tại sao lại đặt những người chẳng được coi ra gì trong Hội Thánh làm quan xét?
vi.R: Vậy khi có những tranh chấp về những việc thường ngày, tại sao anh chị em lại chọn những người hoàn toàn không có chỗ đứng trong Hội Thánh làm quan tòa?

ko.L: 그러니 여러분에게 이 세상 일에 관한 사건들이 있으면, 교회에서 아무것도 아닌 사람들을 [재판관으로] 앉힙니까?
ko.B: 그런데 여러분은 일상의 일로 소송이 생기면, 어째서 교회에서 아무 인정도 받지 못하는 사람들을 재판관으로 앉힙니까?
ko.R: 그런데 여러분은 일상의 일로 다툼이 생기면, 왜 교회에서 아무 위치도 없는 사람들을 재판관으로 고릅니까?

decisions.choice: a question: do you really appoint as judges those who have no standing in the church?
alternatives: an ironic command: appoint even the least respected members of the church as judges
decisions.reason: καθίζετε; can be a question or a command. The SBLGNT punctuates it as a question, and this fits verses 1 and 6, where the judges are unbelievers. Read as a command, Paul would be saying sarcastically that the lowliest believer would do better than a pagan court; verse 5, where he looks for someone wise, sits less easily with that.

decisions.choice: of no account in the church: the outside judges, whose verdicts carry no weight in the church's life
alternatives: the lowliest or least respected members of the church
decisions.reason: ἐξουθενημένους means "regarded as nothing". On the reading taken in m1, Paul is not telling believers to despise the judges as people; he means that their judgment has no standing among God's people, who will judge the world.

decisions.choice: cases: disputes needing a decision
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: as judges
decisions.reason: The verb means to seat someone on a judge's bench; English needs the words "as judges" to say so.

decisions.choice: l’église, lowercase
decisions.reason: The church here is the congregation at Corinth, so the style guide's lowercase for one local church applies.

source.text: πρὸς ἐντροπὴν ὑμῖν λέγω.

records.literal_gloss: For shame to you I say.

en.L: I say [this] to your shame.
en.B: I say this to shame you.
en.R: I am saying this to make you ashamed.

fr.L: Je [le] dis à votre honte.
fr.B: Je dis cela pour vous faire honte.
fr.R: Je dis cela pour que vous ayez honte.

es.L: Para {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vergüenza [lo] digo.
es.B: Digo esto para {{plural_you:avergonzarlos|avergonzaros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo esto para que {{plural_you:sientan|sintáis}} vergüenza.

sw.L: Nasema [haya] kwa aibu yenu.
sw.B: Nasema hivi ili kuwaaibisha.
sw.R: Nasema hivi ili mjisikie aibu.

vi.L: Tôi nói [điều này] để anh chị em xấu hổ.
vi.B: Tôi nói điều này để anh chị em phải xấu hổ.
vi.R: Tôi nói điều này để anh chị em biết xấu hổ.

ko.L: 내가 여러분을 부끄럽게 하려고 [이렇게] 말합니다.
ko.B: 나는 여러분을 부끄럽게 하려고 이 말을 합니다.
ko.R: 나는 여러분이 부끄러운 줄 알게 하려고 이 말을 합니다.

decisions.choice: to shame you: Paul means them to feel ashamed
decisions.reason: In 4:14 Paul said he did not write to shame them. Here he does: in a culture where honor and shame governed public life, taking a fellow believer before an outside court shamed the church, and Paul wants them to feel it. ἐντροπὴν is the same root as the verb in 4:14.

decisions.choice: this
decisions.reason: English needs an object for "say".

source.text: οὕτως οὐκ ἔνι ἐν ὑμῖν οὐδεὶς σοφὸς ὃς δυνήσεται διακρῖναι ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ ἀδελφὸς μετὰ ἀδελφοῦ κρίνεται, καὶ τοῦτο ἐπὶ ἀπίστων;

records.literal_gloss: So not is there among you no one wise who will be able to decide between the brother of him, \v 6 but brother with brother goes to law, and this before unbelievers?

en.L: Is it so, that there is not among you one wise [person] who will be able to decide between {{gender:his brother or sister|his brother}} [and another], \v 6 but {{gender:brother or sister|brother}} goes to law with {{gender:brother or sister|brother}}, and this before unbelievers?
en.B: Is there really no one among you with wisdom enough to settle a case between {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, \v 6 so that instead believers go to law against one another, and before unbelievers at that?
en.R: Is there not one wise person among you who can settle a quarrel between believers? \v 6 Instead, one believer takes another to court, and lets unbelievers judge the case!

fr.L: En est-il ainsi, qu’il n’y ait parmi vous personne de sage qui pourra décider entre {{gender:son frère ou sa sœur|son frère}} [et un autre], \v 6 mais que {{gender:frère ou sœur|frère}} aille en justice avec {{gender:frère ou sœur|frère}}, et cela devant des incroyants ?
fr.B: N’y a-t-il vraiment parmi vous personne d’assez sage pour régler un différend entre {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, \v 6 pour qu’au contraire des croyants aillent en justice les uns contre les autres, et cela devant des incroyants ?
fr.R: N’y a-t-il pas une seule personne sage parmi vous qui puisse régler une dispute entre croyants ? \v 6 Au contraire, un croyant traîne un autre croyant devant le tribunal, et il laisse des incroyants juger l’affaire !

es.L: ¿Así [es], que no hay entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ni uno sabio que pueda decidir entre su hermano [y otro], \v 6 sino que hermano con hermano va a juicio, y esto ante incrédulos?
es.B: ¿De verdad no hay entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} nadie con suficiente sabiduría para resolver un caso entre hermanos, \v 6 sino que los creyentes van a juicio unos contra otros, y encima ante incrédulos?
es.R: ¿No hay entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ni una persona sabia que pueda resolver un pleito entre creyentes? \v 6 En lugar de eso, un creyente lleva a otro a los tribunales, ¡y deja que los no creyentes juzguen el caso!

sw.L: Je, imefikia hapo, kwamba miongoni mwenu hakuna mtu mmoja mwenye hekima atakayeweza kuamua kati ya ndugu yake [na mwingine], \v 6 bali ndugu anakwenda mahakamani dhidi ya ndugu, na hilo mbele ya wasioamini?
sw.B: Je, kweli hakuna mtu kati yenu mwenye hekima ya kutosha kuamua shauri kati ya ndugu, \v 6 hata waamini wanashtakiana wao kwa wao, tena mbele ya wasioamini?
sw.R: Je, hakuna hata mtu mmoja mwenye hekima kati yenu anayeweza kumaliza ugomvi kati ya waamini? \v 6 Badala yake, mwamini mmoja anampeleka mwingine mahakamani, na kuwaacha wasioamini waamue shauri hilo!

vi.L: Có phải đến nỗi giữa anh chị em không có một người khôn ngoan nào có thể phân xử giữa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình [với nhau], \v 6 mà {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} lại đi kiện {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, và việc ấy lại ở trước mặt những người không tin sao?
vi.B: Thật sự giữa anh chị em không có ai đủ khôn ngoan để phân xử một vụ việc giữa các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} sao, \v 6 đến nỗi các tín hữu lại kiện nhau, mà lại kiện trước mặt những người không tin nữa?
vi.R: Chẳng lẽ trong anh chị em không có lấy một người khôn ngoan có thể giải quyết sự bất hòa giữa các tín hữu sao? \v 6 Thay vào đó, tín hữu này lại kiện tín hữu kia ra tòa, và để cho những người không tin Chúa xét xử vụ việc!

ko.L: 이렇게도 여러분 가운데 자기 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 사이를 판가름해 줄 수 있는 지혜로운 사람이 하나도 없습니까? \v 6 그래서 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}가 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}를 고소하고, 그것도 믿지 않는 사람들 앞에서 그렇게 합니까?
ko.B: 여러분 가운데 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 사이의 일을 판가름해 줄 만큼 지혜로운 사람이 정말 하나도 없습니까? \v 6 그래서 믿는 사람들이 서로 고소하고, 그것도 믿지 않는 사람들 앞에서 그렇게 한다는 말입니까?
ko.R: 여러분 가운데 믿는 사람들 사이의 다툼을 해결해 줄 수 있는 지혜로운 사람이 한 명도 없습니까? \v 6 그런데 오히려 믿는 사람이 다른 믿는 사람을 법정에 고소하고, 믿지 않는 사람들에게 그 일을 재판하게 합니다!

decisions.choice: wise: Paul's irony; a church proud of its wisdom cannot find one wise person
decisions.reason: σοφὸς picks up the theme of 1:18-3:23, where the Corinthians prize wisdom. If they are as wise as they think, someone among them can settle a dispute.

decisions.choice: between his brother: a short way of saying between one believer and another
decisions.reason: The Greek names only one party, "between his brother"; the other party is understood. The sense is a case between two members of the church.

decisions.choice: brother: a fellow member of the church, man or woman
decisions.reason: Paul calls believers brothers as members of one family in Christ. The dispute could be between any two members, so the word includes women.

decisions.choice: unbelievers: the same people called "the unrighteous" in verse 1
decisions.reason: ἀπίστων; makes plain what ἀδίκων meant in verse 1: the judges are people who do not believe. The shame is that the church's quarrels are laid open before them.

decisions.choice: so: introducing an indignant question, "has it come to this?"
decisions.reason: οὕτως here expresses dismay that things are so, rather than pointing back to a particular statement.

decisions.choice: {{gender:his brother or sister|his brother}}, {{gender:brother or sister|brother}} (L); {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} (B)
decisions.reason: The brothers here are any members of the church (m3). Balanced puts the second half as "believers ... against one another" and Readable says "believers", which need no setting.

decisions.choice: believers go to law against one another (B); one believer takes another to court (R)
alternatives: brother goes to law with brother
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the same thing in natural English, with "believers" for the family word.

decisions.choice: {{gender:son frère ou sa sœur|son frère}}, {{gender:frère ou sœur|frère}} (L); {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} (B); croyants (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English (m3). French also needs the possessive inside the span, since "son frère ou sa sœur" changes form. "Personne de sage" (L, B) says "no wise person" with a pronoun French reads as generic.

decisions.choice: hermano, hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in 5:11 and Romans 14:10, Spanish "hermano" and "hermanos" for fellow believers cover men and women (m3), so the English gender spans have no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" already means a brother or a sister, so the English gender spans in this chapter (verses 5, 6, 8) have nothing to switch in Swahili.

decisions.choice: {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} for adelphos, singular and plural, in 6:5-8 (L, B); "tín hữu" (B in verse 6, R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:11: the span carries the Greek word for a fellow believer, man or woman; where the English says "believers", so does the Vietnamese.

source.text: ἤδη μὲν οὖν ὅλως ἥττημα ὑμῖν ἐστιν ὅτι κρίματα ἔχετε μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν· διὰ τί οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἀδικεῖσθε;

records.literal_gloss: Already indeed then altogether a defeat for you it is that lawsuits you have with yourselves; why not rather are you wronged?

en.L: Already, indeed, it is altogether a defeat for you that you have lawsuits with one another. Why not rather be wronged?
en.B: Simply by having lawsuits against one another you are already defeated, whatever the verdict. Why not accept being wronged instead?
en.R: When you take each other to court, you have already lost, whoever wins the case. Why not simply let yourself be treated unfairly?

fr.L: Déjà, en vérité, c’est absolument une défaite pour vous que vous ayez des procès les uns avec les autres. Pourquoi ne subissez-vous pas plutôt l’injustice ?
fr.B: Le seul fait d’avoir des procès les uns contre les autres est déjà une défaite pour vous, quel que soit le jugement. Pourquoi ne pas plutôt accepter de subir l’injustice ?
fr.R: Quand vous vous traînez en justice les uns les autres, vous avez déjà perdu, peu importe qui gagne le procès. Pourquoi ne pas simplement accepter qu’on soit injuste envers vous ?

es.L: Ya, en efecto, es del todo una derrota para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} pleitos entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:sufren|sufrís}} más bien la injusticia?
es.B: Con solo tener pleitos unos contra otros, ya {{plural_you:han|habéis}} perdido, sea cual sea el veredicto. ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:aceptan|aceptáis}} más bien que se {{plural_you:les|os}} haga una injusticia?
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:se llevan|os lleváis}} unos a otros a los tribunales, ya {{plural_you:han|habéis}} perdido, gane quien gane el caso. ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:dejan|dejáis}} simplemente que {{plural_you:los|os}} traten injustamente?

sw.L: Basi tayari ni kushindwa kabisa kwenu kwamba mna mashtaka ninyi kwa ninyi. Kwa nini isiwe heri zaidi kudhulumiwa?
sw.B: Kwa kuwa tu mnashtakiana ninyi kwa ninyi, tayari mmeshindwa, hukumu iwe vyovyote. Kwa nini msikubali kutendewa vibaya badala yake?
sw.R: Mnaposhtakiana, tayari mmeshindwa, hata awe nani atakayeshinda kesi. Kwa nini msikubali tu kutendewa isivyo haki?

vi.L: Thật ra, việc anh chị em kiện cáo nhau đã hoàn toàn là một sự thất bại cho anh chị em rồi. Sao không đành chịu thiệt thòi thì hơn?
vi.B: Chỉ việc anh chị em kiện cáo nhau thôi là anh chị em đã thua rồi, dù bản án có ra sao. Sao không đành chịu thiệt thòi thì hơn?
vi.R: Khi anh chị em kiện nhau ra tòa, anh chị em đã thua rồi, dù ai thắng vụ kiện. Sao không chịu để mình bị đối xử bất công?

ko.L: 여러분이 서로 소송하는 것부터가 이미 여러분에게 완전한 패배입니다. 왜 차라리 불의를 당하지 않습니까?
ko.B: 여러분이 서로 소송을 한다는 것 자체가, 판결이 어떻게 나든 이미 진 것입니다. 왜 차라리 억울한 일을 당하지 않습니까?
ko.R: 여러분이 서로 법정에 고소하면, 누가 이기든 여러분은 이미 진 것입니다. 왜 차라리 부당한 대우를 받고 그냥 참지 않습니까?

decisions.choice: defeat: a loss; they have lost before any case is decided
decisions.reason: ἥττημα means a defeat or loss, and can shade into failure. With ἤδη ("already") and ὅλως ("altogether"), Paul says that going to court against one another is itself a loss, whoever wins.

decisions.choice: let yourselves be wronged: accepting wrong rather than suing
decisions.reason: ἀδικεῖσθε; is a middle or passive form: "allow yourselves to be wronged". Paul asks why they do not choose to suffer the loss.

decisions.choice: perhaps an echo of Jesus' teaching not to resist the one who does wrong
decisions.reason: Jesus taught his followers to give more to the one who sues them rather than fight back (Matthew 5:39-40). Paul does not quote him here, so the echo is possible, not certain.

decisions.choice: with one another: the reflexive used for each other
decisions.reason: ἑαυτῶν (literally "yourselves") is used here, as often, for a relation between members of the group.

decisions.choice: whatever the verdict (B); whoever wins the case (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out what "already" means: the loss comes before any verdict (m1).

source.text: διὰ τί οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἀποστερεῖσθε;

records.literal_gloss: Why not rather are you defrauded?

en.L: Why not rather be defrauded?
en.B: Why not accept being cheated instead?
en.R: Why not simply let yourself be cheated?

fr.L: Pourquoi ne vous laissez-vous pas plutôt dépouiller ?
fr.B: Pourquoi ne pas plutôt accepter qu’on vous vole ?
fr.R: Pourquoi ne pas simplement vous laisser voler ?

es.L: ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:se dejan|os dejáis}} más bien despojar?
es.B: ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:aceptan|aceptáis}} más bien que {{plural_you:los|os}} defrauden?
es.R: ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:dejan|dejáis}} simplemente que {{plural_you:les|os}} quiten lo que es {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}}?

sw.L: Kwa nini isiwe heri zaidi kunyimwa kilicho chenu?
sw.B: Kwa nini msikubali kudanganywa badala yake?
sw.R: Kwa nini msikubali tu kudanganywa?

vi.L: Sao không đành chịu bị lường gạt thì hơn?
vi.B: Sao không đành chịu bị lừa thì hơn?
vi.R: Sao không chịu để mình bị lừa?

ko.L: 왜 차라리 빼앗기지 않습니까?
ko.B: 왜 차라리 속임을 당하지 않습니까?
ko.R: 왜 차라리 속아 주고 그냥 넘어가지 않습니까?

decisions.choice: defrauded: robbed of what is rightly one's own
decisions.reason: ἀποστερεῖσθε; means to take or keep back what belongs to another, as in the commandment Jesus quotes in Mark 10:19. It suggests that the lawsuits were about money or property.

decisions.choice: cheated
decisions.reason: "Cheated" is the everyday word; Literal keeps "defrauded".

decisions.choice: dépouiller (L); voler (B, R); the same verbs in 6:8
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "dépouiller", taking from someone what is rightly theirs (m1). Balanced and Readable use the everyday verb, as the English says "cheated". "Escroquer" is kept apart for the swindlers of the vice list.

decisions.choice: despojar (L); defraudar (B); quitar lo que es suyo (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means robbing someone of what is rightly theirs (m1). Spanish keeps "estafador" for the different word in the vice list (5:10-11; 6:10), so here Literal says "despojar", Balanced "defraudar", and verse 8 follows.

source.text: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς ἀδικεῖτε καὶ ἀποστερεῖτε, καὶ τοῦτο ἀδελφούς.

records.literal_gloss: But you do wrong and defraud, and this brothers.

en.L: But you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that [to] {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}.
en.B: Instead, you yourselves do the wronging and the cheating, and to your own {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}!
en.R: But instead you are the ones who treat others unfairly and cheat them. And you do it to your own {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} in the faith!

fr.L: Mais vous, vous commettez l’injustice et vous dépouillez, et cela [envers des] {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}.
fr.B: Au contraire, c’est vous qui commettez l’injustice et qui volez, et cela envers vos propres {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} !
fr.R: Mais au contraire, c’est vous qui êtes injustes envers les autres et qui les volez. Et vous le faites à vos propres {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} dans la foi !

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos {{plural_you:cometen|cometéis}} injusticia y {{plural_you:defraudan|defraudáis}}, y eso a hermanos.
es.B: En cambio, {{plural_you:son ustedes|sois vosotros}} los que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} injusticia y {{plural_you:defraudan|defraudáis}}, ¡y a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} propios hermanos!
es.R: Pero, en lugar de eso, {{plural_you:son ustedes|sois vosotros}} los que {{plural_you:tratan|tratáis}} injustamente a otros y les {{plural_you:quitan|quitáis}} lo que es suyo. ¡Y lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} propios hermanos en la fe!

sw.L: Lakini ninyi wenyewe mnadhulumu na kuwanyima watu kilicho chao, na hilo [kwa] ndugu.
sw.B: Badala yake, ninyi wenyewe ndio mnaodhulumu na kudanganya, tena ndugu zenu wenyewe!
sw.R: Lakini badala yake ninyi ndio mnaowatendea wengine isivyo haki na kuwadanganya. Tena mnawafanyia hivyo ndugu zenu katika imani!

vi.L: Nhưng chính anh chị em lại làm điều bất công và lường gạt, mà lại [đối với] {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} nữa.
vi.B: Trái lại, chính anh chị em lại là người làm điều bất công và lừa gạt, mà lại lừa gạt chính các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của mình!
vi.R: Nhưng ngược lại, chính anh chị em là những người đối xử bất công và lừa gạt người khác. Và anh chị em lại làm như thế với chính các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} trong đức tin của mình!

ko.L: 그런데 여러분이 불의를 행하고 빼앗고 있으며, 그것도 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 [그렇게 합니다].
ko.B: 오히려 여러분 자신이 불의를 행하고 속이고 있습니다. 그것도 여러분의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 말입니다!
ko.R: 그런데 오히려 여러분이 다른 사람들을 부당하게 대하고 속이고 있습니다. 그것도 믿음 안에서 한 가족인 여러분의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들에게 그렇게 합니다!

decisions.choice: you yourselves: far from accepting wrong, they are the ones who do it
decisions.reason: ὑμεῖς is emphatic. The same two verbs as in verse 7 now have the Corinthians as their subject.

decisions.choice: brothers: fellow believers, men and women, members of one family
decisions.reason: The wrong is worse because it is done within God's family.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Fellow believers, men and women (m2).

source.text: Ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἄδικοι θεοῦ βασιλείαν οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν;

records.literal_gloss: Or not do you know that unrighteous [ones] of God [the] kingdom not will inherit?

en.L: Or do you not know that [the] unrighteous will not inherit [the] kingdom of God?
en.B: Or do you not know that people who do wrong will not receive God's kingdom as their inheritance?
en.R: Do you not know that people who do wrong will have no place in God's kingdom?

fr.L: Ou ne savez-vous pas que les injustes n’hériteront pas du royaume de Dieu ?
fr.B: Ou ne savez-vous pas que ceux qui commettent l’injustice ne recevront pas le royaume de Dieu en héritage ?
fr.R: Ne savez-vous pas que les gens injustes n’auront pas de place dans le royaume de Dieu ?

es.L: ¿O no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que [los] injustos no heredarán [el] reino de Dios?
es.B: ¿O no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que los que hacen el mal no recibirán el reino de Dios como herencia?
es.R: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que la gente que hace el mal no tendrá lugar en el reino de Dios?

sw.L: Au hamjui kwamba wasio waadilifu hawataurithi ufalme wa Mungu?
sw.B: Au hamjui kwamba watu wanaotenda maovu hawatapokea ufalme wa Mungu kama urithi wao?
sw.R: Je, hamjui kwamba watu wanaotenda maovu hawatakuwa na nafasi katika ufalme wa Mungu?

vi.L: Hay anh chị em không biết rằng những kẻ bất chính sẽ không thừa hưởng vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời sao?

decisions.choice: the unrighteous: those whose lives are marked by wrongdoing
decisions.reason: ἄδικοι picks up ἀδίκων in verse 1 and the verb in verse 8 ("you do wrong"). The play on words warns the Corinthians: by wronging one another they are acting like the people who will not inherit the kingdom.

decisions.choice: inherit the kingdom of God: receive a share in God's rule when it comes in full
decisions.reason: Israel received the land as an inheritance; in the New Testament God's people inherit his kingdom (15:50; Galatians 5:21; Matthew 25:34). The future tense looks to the end.

decisions.choice: people who do wrong; receive ... as their inheritance (B); have no place in (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the link with verse 8 ("do wrong", m1). Readable says plainly what inheriting the kingdom means.

decisions.choice: ceux qui commettent l’injustice (B); les gens injustes (R)
decisions.reason: French keeps the link with verse 8 ("vous commettez l’injustice") through the "injustice" family, as the English does through "do wrong" (m1). "Le royaume de Dieu" at every level, as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: hawataurithi ufalme wa Mungu (L); hawatapokea ufalme wa Mungu kama urithi wao (B)
decisions.reason: As in Swahili Galatians 5:21: Literal keeps the verb "kurithi" (inherit), Balanced spells out the picture of an inheritance, and Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "thừa hưởng vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" (L, B); "có phần trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" (R) (also 6:10)

decisions.choice: "유산으로 받다" (L, B) for inheriting the kingdom, here, in verse 10 and in 15:50
decisions.reason: "유산" is the word of Galatians and Colossians for an inheritance given, not earned; "기업" now means a business company.

records.literal_gloss: Not be deceived: neither sexually immoral nor idolaters nor adulterers nor soft [ones] nor male-bedders \v 10 nor thieves nor greedy [ones], not drunkards, not abusive [ones], not swindlers [the] kingdom of God will inherit.

en.L: Do not be deceived: neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor soft [men], nor men who lie with males, \v 10 nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor abusive [people], nor swindlers will inherit [the] kingdom of God.
en.B: Make no mistake: the sexually immoral, idolaters, adulterers, men who take the passive part in sex with men, men who go to bed with males, \v 10 thieves, the greedy, drunkards, abusive people, and swindlers: none of these will receive God's kingdom as their inheritance.
en.R: Do not fool yourselves. People who commit sexual sins, who worship idols, or who are unfaithful in marriage will have no place in God's kingdom. Neither will men who let other men have sex with them, or men who have sex with other men. \v 10 People who steal, who are greedy, who get drunk, who insult people, or who cheat others will have no place in God's kingdom either.

fr.L: Ne vous égarez pas : ni les débauchés, ni les idolâtres, ni les adultères, ni les [hommes] mous, ni les hommes qui couchent avec des mâles, \v 10 ni les voleurs, ni les cupides, ni les ivrognes, ni les [gens] injurieux, ni les escrocs n’hériteront du royaume de Dieu.
fr.B: Ne vous y trompez pas : les débauchés, les idolâtres, les adultères, les hommes qui tiennent le rôle passif dans les relations sexuelles entre hommes, les hommes qui couchent avec des hommes, \v 10 les voleurs, les cupides, les ivrognes, les gens injurieux et les escrocs : aucun d’eux ne recevra le royaume de Dieu en héritage.
fr.R: Ne vous faites pas d’illusions. Les gens qui commettent des péchés sexuels, qui adorent des idoles ou qui sont infidèles dans leur mariage n’auront pas de place dans le royaume de Dieu. Les hommes qui laissent d’autres hommes avoir des relations sexuelles avec eux, et les hommes qui ont des relations sexuelles avec d’autres hommes, n’en auront pas non plus. \v 10 Les gens qui volent, qui sont avides, qui s’enivrent, qui insultent les gens ou qui trompent les autres n’auront pas non plus de place dans le royaume de Dieu.

es.L: No {{plural_you:se engañen|os engañéis}}: ni los sexualmente inmorales, ni los idólatras, ni los adúlteros, ni los [hombres] blandos, ni los hombres que se acuestan con varones, \v 10 ni los ladrones, ni los avaros, ni los borrachos, ni los insultadores, ni los estafadores heredarán [el] reino de Dios.
es.B: No {{plural_you:se dejen|os dejéis}} engañar: los sexualmente inmorales, los idólatras, los adúlteros, los hombres que toman el papel pasivo en el sexo con hombres, los hombres que se acuestan con varones, \v 10 los ladrones, los avaros, los borrachos, los insultadores y los estafadores: ninguno de ellos recibirá el reino de Dios como herencia.
es.R: No {{plural_you:se engañen|os engañéis}}. Las personas que cometen pecados sexuales, que adoran ídolos o que son infieles en el matrimonio no tendrán lugar en el reino de Dios. Tampoco lo tendrán los hombres que dejan que otros hombres tengan relaciones sexuales con ellos, ni los hombres que tienen relaciones sexuales con otros hombres. \v 10 Las personas que roban, que son avaras, que se emborrachan, que insultan a la gente o que estafan a otros tampoco tendrán lugar en el reino de Dios.
