vi.L: Đừng bị lừa dối: cả những kẻ tà dâm, những kẻ thờ thần tượng, những kẻ ngoại tình, những người [nam] mềm yếu, những người nam ăn nằm với người nam, \v 10 những kẻ trộm cắp, những kẻ tham lam, những kẻ say sưa, những kẻ chửi rủa, những kẻ lừa đảo, đều sẽ không thừa hưởng vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Đừng để mình bị lừa dối: những người tà dâm, thờ thần tượng, ngoại tình, những người nam đóng vai bị động trong quan hệ tình dục với người nam, những người nam ăn nằm với người nam, \v 10 những người trộm cắp, tham lam, say sưa, chửi rủa và lừa đảo: không ai trong số đó sẽ được thừa hưởng vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Đừng tự lừa dối mình. Những người phạm tội tình dục, thờ thần tượng, hay không chung thủy trong hôn nhân sẽ không có phần trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời. Những người nam để cho người nam khác quan hệ tình dục với mình, hay những người nam quan hệ tình dục với người nam khác, cũng vậy. \v 10 Những người trộm cắp, tham lam, say rượu, sỉ nhục người khác hay lừa gạt người khác cũng sẽ không có phần trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 속지 마십시오. 음행하는 사람들도, 우상을 숭배하는 사람들도, 간음하는 사람들도, 부드러운 [남자들]도, 남자와 동침하는 남자들도, \v 10 도둑질하는 사람들도, 탐욕을 부리는 사람들도, 술 취하는 사람들도, 남을 모욕하는 사람들도, 남의 것을 빼앗는 사람들도 하나님의 나라를 유산으로 받지 못할 것입니다.
ko.B: 잘못 생각하지 마십시오. 음행하는 사람들, 우상을 숭배하는 사람들, 간음하는 사람들, 남자와의 성관계에서 수동적인 역할을 하는 남자들, 남자와 잠자리를 같이하는 남자들, \v 10 도둑질하는 사람들, 탐욕을 부리는 사람들, 술 취하는 사람들, 남을 모욕하는 사람들, 남의 것을 빼앗는 사람들, 이런 사람들은 아무도 하나님의 나라를 유산으로 받지 못할 것입니다.
ko.R: 스스로 속지 마십시오. 성적인 죄를 짓는 사람들이나 우상을 섬기는 사람들이나 결혼한 상대를 두고 바람을 피우는 사람들은 하나님의 나라에 들어갈 자리가 없을 것입니다. 다른 남자가 자기와 성관계를 하게 하는 남자들이나 다른 남자와 성관계를 하는 남자들도 마찬가지입니다. \v 10 남의 것을 훔치는 사람들, 욕심이 많은 사람들, 술에 취하는 사람들, 남에게 욕하는 사람들, 남을 속이는 사람들도 하나님의 나라에 들어갈 자리가 없을 것입니다.

decisions.choice: do not be deceived: stop letting yourselves be led astray
decisions.reason: μὴ πλανᾶσθε warns against a belief that how one lives does not matter for those who belong to God. The sayings Paul quotes in verses 12-13 show such a belief in Corinth.

decisions.choice: the sexually immoral: people who engage in any sexual relationship outside marriage
decisions.reason: πόρνοι is related to the word for a prostitute (verses 15-16) but in lists like this covers every kind of sexual sin, including the case in 5:1. The masculine form is used for everyone, as in such lists generally.

decisions.choice: men who take the passive part in sex between males
alternatives: "soft" in a broad moral sense: men given to luxury and lacking self-control, with no sexual sense in particular
boys or young men kept for sex by older men, or male prostitutes
decisions.reason: μαλακοὶ means "soft": in Matthew 11:8 it describes fine clothing. Said of men, it was a term of contempt for men thought unmanly, and it was used especially of males who let themselves be penetrated by other men, sometimes boys or young men kept for that purpose. Here it stands among sexual sins, between adulterers and ἀρσενοκοῖται, and that setting points to the sexual sense. The word can carry the broader sense of self-indulgence, and some read it that way here. Paul names conduct; he does not describe inclinations or sexual orientation, ideas the Greek words do not contain.

decisions.choice: men who have sex with males
alternatives: men who exploit others sexually, as in the use of boys or of slaves and prostitutes
a broader sense of exploitation, including economic
decisions.reason: ἀρσενοκοῖται joins the words for "male" and "bed" (in the sense of sexual intercourse). It is not found in any surviving Greek writing before Paul; it appears again in 1 Timothy 1:10. The two parts stand side by side in the Greek of Leviticus 20:13, and close together in 18:22, the laws that forbid a man to lie with a male, and the word was most likely formed from those laws. Those laws forbid sex between males of every kind, not only exploitative forms, and with μαλακοὶ beside it the pair most likely names both partners. Some argue that the word, being new and rare, meant something narrower, such as sexual exploitation of others. Again Paul names acts, not orientation.

decisions.choice: abusive people: those who insult and revile others; swindlers: those who seize what is not theirs, by force or by fraud
alternatives: slanderers; robbers in the narrow sense
decisions.reason: λοίδοροι are people who hurl abuse at others with their words. ἅρπαγες are grasping people who take others' goods by force or by fraud; the word looks back to the defrauding in verses 7-8. Both appear in the list of 5:11.

decisions.choice: the greedy: people always grasping for more, at the expense of others
decisions.reason: πλεονέκται describes those who want more than their share; Colossians 3:5 calls such greed idolatry.

decisions.choice: the list describes ways of life persisted in, not sins beyond forgiveness
decisions.reason: Paul warns that those who live like this will not inherit the kingdom, but verse 11 says at once that some of the Corinthians once lived like this and have been washed, made holy and put right with God. The list includes greed and abusive speech alongside sexual sins; no one item stands apart from the others.

decisions.choice: soft [men], men who lie with males (L); men who take the passive part in sex with men, men who go to bed with males (B); men who let other men have sex with them, men who have sex with other men (R)
decisions.reason: The two Greek words stay two items at every level (m3, m4). "Homosexuals" names an orientation, a modern idea the Greek words do not express; "effeminate" in modern English describes manner, not conduct; "sodomites" brings in a later reading of Genesis 19. Literal keeps "soft" so the reader can see the Greek word, and "lie with males" keeps the echo of Leviticus.

decisions.choice: the list first, then "none of these will receive God's kingdom" (B); two sentences, each ending "will have no place in God's kingdom" (R)
decisions.reason: A long chain of "neither ... nor" is hard to follow aloud. Balanced lists the people first and then sums up; Readable breaks the list into short sentences.

decisions.choice: abusive [people], swindlers (L); abusive people, swindlers (B); insult people, cheat others (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:10-11, where the same words appear: "revilers" is little used today, and "swindlers" covers taking by fraud as well as by force (m5).

decisions.choice: les [hommes] mous, les hommes qui couchent avec des mâles (L); two descriptions of acts (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English, the two Greek words stay two items at every level and describe acts, not an orientation (m3, m4). "Efféminés" describes manner, "homosexuels" an orientation, and "pédérastes" and "sodomites" bring in meanings the meaning decisions do not support. Literal keeps the literal "mous", with the sense left to the meaning decision and its footnote.

decisions.choice: débauchés, idolâtres, cupides, ivrognes, injurieux, escrocs (L, B); adultères; voleurs
decisions.reason: The words of the lists in 5:10-11 are used again so that the reader can see the lists are the same; Readable uses its descriptions from 5:11.

decisions.choice: [hombres] blandos, hombres que se acuestan con varones (L); hombres que toman el papel pasivo en el sexo con hombres, hombres que se acuestan con varones (B); hombres que dejan que otros hombres tengan relaciones sexuales con ellos, hombres que tienen relaciones sexuales con otros hombres (R)
decisions.reason: As in English, the two words stay two items at every level and describe acts, as the meaning decisions read them (m3, m4, footnoted). Spanish never says "afeminados", "homosexuales" or "sodomitas": the first speaks of manner, not acts, and the others name an orientation or carry later legal and church meanings the Greek words do not have. Literal "blandos" is the plain sense of the first word.

decisions.choice: the vice list as in 5:10-11
decisions.reason: The items shared with 5:10-11 keep the same Spanish words: "sexualmente inmorales", "idólatras", "avaros", "borrachos", "insultadores", "estafadores" (L, B), and at Readable "cometen pecados sexuales", "adoran ídolos", "insultan a la gente", "estafan a otros".

decisions.choice: [wanaume] laini, [wanaume] walalao na wanaume (L); wanaume wanaokubali kutendwa kingono na wanaume, wanaume wanaolala na wanaume (B); wanaume wanaowaruhusu wanaume wengine kufanya ngono nao, wanaume wanaofanya ngono na wanaume wengine (R)
decisions.reason: Following the meaning decisions and the book-wide choice for this verse: the two Greek words stay two items at every level and describe acts, not an orientation. "Mashoga" names a kind of person and is often used as an insult, and "wafiraji" and "walawiti" are legal terms for an offence; none says what the Greek says.

decisions.choice: waasherati, wenye tamaa ya mali, walevi, watukanaji, walaghai (L, B); verbs for what people do (R)
decisions.reason: The vice list in the same words as in 5:10–11.

decisions.choice: "những người [nam] mềm yếu, những người nam ăn nằm với người nam" (L); "những người nam đóng vai bị động trong quan hệ tình dục với người nam, những người nam ăn nằm với người nam" (B); "những người nam để cho người nam khác quan hệ tình dục với mình, những người nam quan hệ tình dục với người nam khác" (R)
decisions.reason: As the book-wide choice requires, the two Greek words stay two items at every level and describe acts, not an orientation; the meaning decisions give the evidence and the debated alternatives (m3, m4). "Ăn nằm với người nam" is the Literal of the Vietnamese 1 Timothy 1:10 for the second word. Literal keeps "mềm yếu" (soft) for the first, with "nam" bracketed; "ẻo lả" would add a judgment about manner that the English also avoids.

decisions.choice: the vice list in the words of 5:10-11 ("kẻ" at Literal, "người" at Balanced), with "ngoại tình" and "trộm cắp" added
decisions.reason: The list recurs in the same words, so the reader sees that it is one list.

decisions.choice: two items at every level: "부드러운 [남자들] ... 남자와 동침하는 남자들" (L); "남자와의 성관계에서 수동적인 역할을 하는 남자들 ... 남자와 잠자리를 같이하는 남자들" (B); "다른 남자가 자기와 성관계를 하게 하는 남자들 ... 다른 남자와 성관계를 하는 남자들" (R)
decisions.reason: The project's choice for these verses keeps the two Greek words as two items, describing acts, never orientation, so Korean never says "동성애자". The older words "탐색", "남색" are not current Korean. The meaning decisions give the evidence and the debated alternatives.

decisions.choice: the vice list in the words of 5:10-11: "음행하는 사람, 탐욕을 부리는 사람, 술 취하는 사람, 남을 모욕하는 사람, 남의 것을 빼앗는 사람" (L, B) and "성적인 죄를 짓는 사람, 욕심이 많은 사람, 술에 취하는 사람, 남에게 욕하는 사람, 남을 속이는 사람" (R)
alternatives: new words for the repeated list
decisions.reason: The list recurs, so Korean keeps the same words.

source.text: καὶ ταῦτά τινες ἦτε· ἀλλὰ ἀπελούσασθε, ἀλλὰ ἡγιάσθητε, ἀλλὰ ἐδικαιώθητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And these things some [of you] were; but you were washed, but you were made holy, but you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus and in the Spirit of the God of us.

en.L: And such were some [of you]. But you were washed, but you were made holy, but you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus and by the Spirit of our God.
en.B: Some of you once lived in these ways. But you have been washed clean; you have been made holy; you have been put right with God, in the name of the Lord Jesus and through the Spirit of our God.
en.R: Some of you used to be like that. But God has washed your sins away. He has made you holy and has put you right with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. All this happened through the name of the Lord Jesus and through the Spirit of our God.

fr.L: Et voilà ce qu’étaient certains [d’entre vous]. Mais vous avez été lavés, mais vous avez été sanctifiés, mais vous avez été justifiés au nom du Seigneur Jésus et par l’Esprit de notre Dieu.
fr.B: Certains d’entre vous vivaient autrefois de cette façon. Mais vous avez été lavés ; vous avez été rendus saints ; vous avez été déclarés justes, au nom du Seigneur Jésus et par l’Esprit de notre Dieu.
fr.R: Certains d’entre vous étaient comme cela autrefois. Mais Dieu a lavé vos péchés. Il vous a rendus saints et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a mis en règle avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Tout cela s’est fait par le nom du Seigneur Jésus et par l’Esprit de notre Dieu.

es.L: Y algunos [de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}] eran esto. Pero {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} lavados, pero {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} santificados, pero {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} justificados en el nombre del Señor Jesús y por el Espíritu de nuestro Dios.
es.B: Algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} vivían antes así. Pero {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido lavados; {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido santificados; {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido justificados ante Dios, en el nombre del Señor Jesús y por medio del Espíritu de nuestro Dios.
es.R: Algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} eran así antes. Pero Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha lavado los pecados. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} ha hecho santos y {{plural_you:los|os}} ha puesto en una relación correcta con {{deity_pronoun:él mismo|Él mismo}}. Todo esto sucedió por medio del nombre del Señor Jesús y por medio del Espíritu de nuestro Dios.

sw.L: Na baadhi [yenu] mlikuwa hivyo. Lakini mlisafishwa, lakini mlitakaswa, lakini mlihesabiwa haki katika jina la Bwana Yesu na kwa Roho wa Mungu wetu.
sw.B: Baadhi yenu mliishi hivyo zamani. Lakini mmeoshwa mkawa safi; mmetakaswa; mmehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu, katika jina la Bwana Yesu na kupitia Roho wa Mungu wetu.
sw.R: Baadhi yenu mlikuwa hivyo zamani. Lakini Mungu ameziosha dhambi zenu. Amewafanya kuwa watakatifu na amewahesabia haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Haya yote yalitokea kupitia jina la Bwana Yesu na kupitia Roho wa Mungu wetu.

vi.L: Và một số [trong anh chị em] đã từng là những người như thế. Nhưng anh chị em đã được rửa sạch, nhưng anh chị em đã được nên thánh, nhưng anh chị em đã được xưng công chính trong danh Chúa Giê-xu và bởi Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.B: Trước đây, một số anh chị em đã từng sống như vậy. Nhưng anh chị em đã được rửa sạch, đã được nên thánh, đã được xưng công chính, trong danh Chúa Giê-xu và qua Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.R: Trước kia, một số anh chị em cũng đã từng như vậy. Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã rửa sạch tội lỗi anh chị em. Ngài đã làm cho anh chị em nên thánh, và đã công nhận anh chị em là công chính trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tất cả những điều đó đã xảy ra nhờ danh Chúa Giê-xu và nhờ Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.

ko.L: 여러분 가운데 어떤 사람들이 이런 사람들이었습니다. 그러나 여러분은 씻겼고, 거룩하게 되었고, 주 예수의 이름으로, 그리고 우리 하나님의 영으로 의롭다고 인정을 받았습니다.
ko.B: 여러분 가운데 어떤 사람들은 전에 이렇게 살았습니다. 그러나 여러분은 주 예수의 이름으로, 그리고 우리 하나님의 영으로 깨끗이 씻겼고, 거룩하게 되었고, 의롭다고 인정을 받았습니다.
ko.R: 여러분 가운데 어떤 사람들은 전에 그런 사람들이었습니다. 그러나 하나님께서 여러분의 죄를 씻어 주셨습니다. 그분이 여러분을 거룩하게 하셨고, 의롭다고 인정해 주셨습니다. 이 모든 일은 주 예수의 이름과 우리 하나님의 영을 통해 일어났습니다.

decisions.choice: such were some of you: a past way of life, now left behind
decisions.reason: The neuter ταῦτά ("these things") sums up the list: this is what some of them were. The past tense ἦτε marks it as over.

decisions.choice: washed: cleansed from sin, probably with baptism in view
alternatives: a cleansing with no reference to baptism
decisions.reason: ἀπελούσασθε can mean "you had yourselves washed", and Acts 22:16 joins being baptized and washing away sins. Paul's point is the cleansing itself, which God gives.

decisions.choice: three ways of describing one change God has made, not three stages in order
alternatives: three steps, one after the other
decisions.reason: Each verb is introduced by ἀλλὰ ("but") and all are in the same past tense. Being washed, made holy and put right with God describe from three sides what happened when they came to Christ, and the sentence names the Lord Jesus, the Spirit and God together as its source.

decisions.choice: justified: declared righteous by God, acquitted at his court
decisions.reason: ἐδικαιώθητε is a word of the law court. In a chapter about believers taking one another to court, Paul reminds them of the verdict God has already given in their favor (compare Romans 5:1; 8:33).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the Lord Jesus"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "Christ", and some "our"; the SBLGNT has the shorter text. The meaning is the same. Reviewers should check the manuscript evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: put right with God (B); put you right with himself (R)
decisions.reason: "Justified" is a church word to many readers; "put right with God" says what God's verdict does (m4). Literal keeps "justified".

decisions.choice: God has washed your sins away. He has made you holy ...
alternatives: you were washed, made holy, justified
decisions.reason: The passive verbs mean that God did these things; Readable names him and says what was washed away (m2).

decisions.choice: justifiés (L); déclarés justes (B); mis en règle avec lui (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's terms for this verb: Literal keeps the church word, Balanced says what God's verdict is (m4), and Readable follows the English "put right with himself".

decisions.choice: justificados ante Dios
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "justificados", the word Romans uses for being declared righteous (Romans 3:24), and adds "ante Dios" to show the courtroom sense of the meaning decision, as the English says "put right with God". Readable says "una relación correcta", as Romans 1:17 does.

decisions.choice: kuhesabiwa haki
decisions.reason: The term settled in Swahili Romans for being declared righteous by God, kept at every level; Readable makes God the subject ("amewahesabia haki"), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "được xưng công chính" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời ... đã công nhận anh chị em là công chính" (R) for dikaioo (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Romans and Galatians for justify, kept at every level as there.

decisions.choice: "의롭다고 인정을 받다" (L, B); "의롭다고 인정해 주시다" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Romans and Galatians for being justified, at every level.

source.text: Πάντα μοι ἔξεστιν· ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα συμφέρει.

records.literal_gloss: All things to me are lawful; but not all things are beneficial.

en.L: "All things are permitted to me"; but not all things are of benefit.
en.B: "Everything is permitted for me." Yes, but not everything is for the good.
en.R: Some of you say, "I am allowed to do anything." That may be true, but not everything is good for you.

fr.L: « Toutes choses me sont permises » ; mais toutes choses ne sont pas profitables.
fr.B: « Tout est permis pour moi. » Oui, mais tout ne fait pas du bien.
fr.R: Certains d’entre vous disent : « J’ai le droit de tout faire. » C’est peut-être vrai, mais tout n’est pas bon pour vous.

es.L: «Todo me está permitido»; pero no todo conviene.
es.B: «Todo me está permitido». Sí, pero no todo es para bien.
es.R: Algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} dicen: «Se me permite hacer cualquier cosa». Puede que sea así, pero no todo hace bien.

sw.L: "Kila kitu kimeruhusiwa kwangu"; lakini si kila kitu kinafaa.
sw.B: "Ninaruhusiwa kufanya kila kitu." Ndiyo, lakini si kila kitu kinaleta mema.
sw.R: Baadhi yenu mnasema, "Ninaruhusiwa kufanya chochote." Huenda ni kweli, lakini si kila kitu ni chema kwenu.

vi.L: "Mọi sự đều được phép đối với tôi"; nhưng không phải mọi sự đều có ích.
vi.B: "Mọi điều đều được phép cho tôi." Đúng vậy, nhưng không phải mọi điều đều đem lại điều tốt.
vi.R: Có người trong anh chị em nói: "Tôi được phép làm bất cứ điều gì." Có thể là như vậy, nhưng không phải điều gì cũng tốt cho anh chị em.

ko.L: "모든 것이 나에게 허용되어 있다." 그러나 모든 것이 유익한 것은 아닙니다.
ko.B: "나에게는 모든 것이 허용되어 있다." 그렇습니다. 그러나 모든 것이 유익한 것은 아닙니다.
ko.R: 여러분 가운데 어떤 사람은 "나는 무엇이든지 해도 된다" 하고 말합니다. 그 말이 맞을지도 모릅니다. 그러나 모든 것이 여러분에게 좋은 것은 아닙니다.

decisions.choice: the words are a saying used in Corinth, which Paul quotes and then qualifies; they are marked as a quotation
alternatives: Paul's own principle, which he then limits
decisions.reason: The Greek has no quotation marks, so this is a judgment. The same saying comes back in this verse and again twice in 10:23, each time followed by Paul's "but". Without limits, "all things are permitted" would contradict what Paul has just said in verses 9-10. It may be the Corinthians' own use of Paul's teaching on freedom, now turned to excuse sexual sin.

decisions.choice: permitted: there is no rule against it; one has the right to do it
alternatives: legal under the law of the land
decisions.reason: ἔξεστιν means "it is allowed". The saying claims a believer's freedom to do as one likes, here with the body.

decisions.choice: beneficial: doing real good, to oneself and to others
decisions.reason: συμφέρει means to help or profit. In 10:23-24 and 12:7 Paul measures it by the good of others as well.

decisions.choice: permitted (L, B); allowed (R)
decisions.reason: "Lawful" now suggests the law of the land; the saying is about freedom from rules.

decisions.choice: Yes, but (B); Some of you say ... That may be true, but (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show that Paul grants the saying in part before he limits it (m1); Readable says whose saying it is.

decisions.choice: «Todo me está permitido» (L, B); Algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} dicen: «...» (R)
decisions.reason: The Corinthian slogans (6:12-13) stand in «» quotation marks at Literal and Balanced, as the meaning decision marks them, and Readable says who is speaking, as the English does. Readable "no todo hace bien" keeps the general saying general, without turning to "you".

decisions.choice: Baadhi yenu mnasema
decisions.reason: As the English Readable: the Corinthian saying is marked as theirs, so the reader does not take it for Paul's own view (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced use quotation marks only.

decisions.choice: the Corinthian sayings in quotation marks (L, B), introduced at Readable with "Có người trong anh chị em nói" (6:12-13; also 7:1; 8:1, 8:4)
decisions.reason: As the book-wide choice says, Paul quotes the Corinthians' own sayings and then answers them (m1); the marks let the reader hear two voices. Readable says who is speaking.

decisions.choice: the Corinthian sayings of verses 12-13 in quotation marks, in the plain style of a slogan; Readable adds "여러분 가운데 어떤 사람은 ... 하고 말합니다"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the words as a saying used in Corinth, which Paul quotes and then corrects; a slogan takes the plain style, and Paul's replies stay in 합쇼체.

source.text: πάντα μοι ἔξεστιν· ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐγὼ ἐξουσιασθήσομαι ὑπό τινος.

records.literal_gloss: All things to me are lawful; but not I will be brought under authority by anything.

en.L: "All things are permitted to me"; but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
en.B: "Everything is permitted for me." Yes, but I will not let anything become my master.
en.R: "I am allowed to do anything." Yes, but I will not let anything control me.

fr.L: « Toutes choses me sont permises » ; mais moi, je ne serai mis sous le pouvoir de rien.
fr.B: « Tout est permis pour moi. » Oui, mais je ne laisserai rien devenir mon maître.
fr.R: « J’ai le droit de tout faire. » Oui, mais je ne laisserai rien me dominer.

es.L: «Todo me está permitido»; pero yo no me dejaré dominar por nada.
es.B: «Todo me está permitido». Sí, pero no dejaré que nada se convierta en mi amo.
es.R: «Se me permite hacer cualquier cosa». Sí, pero no dejaré que nada me controle.

sw.L: "Kila kitu kimeruhusiwa kwangu"; lakini mimi sitawekwa chini ya mamlaka ya kitu chochote.
sw.B: "Ninaruhusiwa kufanya kila kitu." Ndiyo, lakini sitakubali kitu chochote kiwe bwana wangu.
sw.R: "Ninaruhusiwa kufanya chochote." Ndiyo, lakini sitakubali kitu chochote kinitawale.

vi.L: "Mọi sự đều được phép đối với tôi"; nhưng tôi sẽ không để mình bị điều gì cầm quyền.
vi.B: "Mọi điều đều được phép cho tôi." Đúng vậy, nhưng tôi sẽ không để điều gì làm chủ tôi.
vi.R: "Tôi được phép làm bất cứ điều gì." Đúng vậy, nhưng tôi sẽ không để điều gì kiểm soát tôi.

ko.L: "모든 것이 나에게 허용되어 있다." 그러나 나는 어떤 것에도 지배를 받지 않을 것입니다.
ko.B: "나에게는 모든 것이 허용되어 있다." 그렇습니다. 그러나 나는 어떤 것도 나의 주인이 되게 하지 않겠습니다.
ko.R: "나는 무엇이든지 해도 된다." 그렇습니다. 그러나 나는 어떤 것에도 끌려다니지 않겠습니다.

decisions.choice: the Corinthian saying again, marked as a quotation
decisions.reason: As in the first half of the verse (12.s1, m1).

decisions.choice: a play on words: I have the right to all things, but nothing will have the right over me
decisions.reason: ἔξεστιν ("it is permitted") and ἐξουσιασθήσομαι ("I will be brought under the power") come from related words. Paul turns the saying round: freedom used for one's appetites becomes slavery to them.

decisions.choice: anything
alternatives: anyone, perhaps pointing ahead to the prostitute in verse 15
decisions.reason: τινος can be neuter or masculine. The neuter fits the general saying and the appetites of verse 13.

decisions.choice: let anything become my master (B); let anything control me (R)
decisions.reason: An active wording makes Paul's resolve plain and keeps the picture of a master (m2).

decisions.choice: kimeruhusiwa ... chini ya mamlaka
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on two words of one family (meaning decision). Swahili "ruhusa" (permission, right) and "mamlaka" (authority) are the settled words for that family, so Literal says "I will not be put under the authority of anything" to keep the echo as far as Swahili allows.

source.text: τὰ βρώματα τῇ κοιλίᾳ, καὶ ἡ κοιλία τοῖς βρώμασιν· ὁ δὲ θεὸς καὶ ταύτην καὶ ταῦτα καταργήσει.

records.literal_gloss: The foods for the stomach, and the stomach for the foods; but God both this and these will do away with.

en.L: "Foods [are] for the stomach and the stomach for foods, and God will do away with both it and them."
en.B: "Food exists for the stomach and the stomach for food, and in the end God will do away with them both."
en.R: You also say, "Food is for the stomach, and the stomach is for food. And someday God will put an end to both of them."

fr.L: « Les aliments [sont] pour le ventre et le ventre pour les aliments, et Dieu abolira et celui-ci et ceux-là. »
fr.B: « La nourriture est faite pour le ventre et le ventre pour la nourriture, et un jour Dieu les réduira à rien l’un et l’autre. »
fr.R: Vous dites aussi : « La nourriture est pour le ventre, et le ventre est pour la nourriture. Et un jour, Dieu fera disparaître l’un et l’autre. »

es.L: «Los alimentos [son] para el estómago y el estómago para los alimentos, y Dios acabará tanto con este como con aquellos».
es.B: «La comida existe para el estómago y el estómago para la comida, y al final Dios acabará con ambos».
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} también {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: «La comida es para el estómago, y el estómago es para la comida. Y algún día Dios acabará con los dos».

sw.L: "Vyakula [ni] kwa ajili ya tumbo, na tumbo kwa ajili ya vyakula, na Mungu atalibatilisha hilo na hivyo pia."
sw.B: "Chakula kipo kwa ajili ya tumbo, na tumbo kwa ajili ya chakula, na mwishowe Mungu atavikomesha vyote viwili."
sw.R: Tena mnasema, "Chakula ni kwa ajili ya tumbo, na tumbo ni kwa ajili ya chakula. Na siku moja Mungu atavikomesha vyote viwili."

vi.L: "Đồ ăn [là] cho cái bụng, và cái bụng cho đồ ăn; nhưng Đức Chúa Trời sẽ hủy bỏ cả cái này lẫn những thứ kia."
vi.B: "Đồ ăn có là để cho cái bụng, và cái bụng để cho đồ ăn, rồi cuối cùng Đức Chúa Trời sẽ hủy bỏ cả hai."
vi.R: Anh chị em cũng nói: "Đồ ăn là cho cái bụng, và cái bụng là cho đồ ăn. Rồi một ngày kia Đức Chúa Trời sẽ chấm dứt cả hai."

ko.L: "음식은 배를 위하여 있고 배는 음식을 위하여 있으며, 하나님께서는 이것과 저것을 다 없애실 것이다."
ko.B: "음식은 배를 위해 있고 배는 음식을 위해 있으며, 결국 하나님께서는 그 둘을 다 없애실 것이다."
ko.R: 여러분은 또 이렇게 말합니다. "음식은 배를 위해 있고, 배는 음식을 위해 있다. 언젠가 하나님께서 이 둘을 다 없애실 것이다."

decisions.choice: the whole sentence is a second Corinthian saying, marked as a quotation
alternatives: only the first half is the saying, and "God will do away with both" is Paul's own comment
decisions.reason: Paul's reply in verses 13b-14 matches the sentence part for part: the body is not for sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body; God raised the Lord and will raise us. That reply answers "God will do away with both", which suggests these words belong to the saying. Read as Paul's comment, they would say only that food and stomach are temporary.

decisions.choice: the saying's reasoning: bodily appetites are natural and passing, so what one does with the body does not matter
decisions.reason: The saying treats the body as a set of appetites that will perish. The next sentence shows that some applied the same reasoning to sex, which is why Paul answers with the body and sexual immorality.

decisions.choice: stomach: the belly, the organ of eating
decisions.reason: κοιλίᾳ is the belly or stomach, and could stand for bodily appetite (Philippians 3:19).

decisions.choice: do away with: bring to an end, make of no effect
decisions.reason: καταργήσει means to put out of action or bring to nothing, as in 1:28 and 2:6.

decisions.choice: You also say
decisions.reason: Readable says that this is the Corinthians' saying (m1).

source.text: τὸ δὲ σῶμα οὐ τῇ πορνείᾳ ἀλλὰ τῷ κυρίῳ, καὶ ὁ κύριος τῷ σώματι·

records.literal_gloss: But the body not for the sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body;

en.L: But the body [is] not for sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
en.B: The body, however, does not exist for sexual immorality; it exists for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
en.R: But the body is not for sexual sin. It is for the Lord, and the Lord cares about the body.

fr.L: Mais le corps [n’est] pas pour l’immoralité sexuelle, mais pour le Seigneur, et le Seigneur pour le corps.
fr.B: Mais le corps n’est pas fait pour l’immoralité sexuelle ; il est fait pour le Seigneur, et le Seigneur pour le corps.
fr.R: Mais le corps n’est pas fait pour le péché sexuel. Il est pour le Seigneur, et le Seigneur se soucie du corps.

es.L: Pero el cuerpo no [es] para la inmoralidad sexual, sino para el Señor, y el Señor para el cuerpo.
es.B: Sin embargo, el cuerpo no existe para la inmoralidad sexual; existe para el Señor, y el Señor para el cuerpo.
es.R: Pero el cuerpo no es para el pecado sexual. Es para el Señor, y al Señor le importa el cuerpo.

sw.L: Lakini mwili [si] kwa ajili ya uasherati bali kwa ajili ya Bwana, na Bwana kwa ajili ya mwili.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, mwili haupo kwa ajili ya uasherati; upo kwa ajili ya Bwana, na Bwana kwa ajili ya mwili.
sw.R: Lakini mwili si kwa ajili ya dhambi ya ngono. Ni kwa ajili ya Bwana, na Bwana anaujali mwili.

vi.L: Nhưng thân thể không [phải] cho sự tà dâm, nhưng cho Chúa, và Chúa cho thân thể.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, thân thể không phải để cho sự tà dâm; thân thể là để cho Chúa, và Chúa là để cho thân thể.
vi.R: Nhưng thân thể không phải để phạm tội tình dục. Thân thể là để cho Chúa, và Chúa quan tâm đến thân thể.

ko.L: 그러나 몸은 음행을 위하여 [있는 것이] 아니라 주님을 위하여 [있고], 주님은 몸을 위하여 [계십니다].
ko.B: 그러나 몸은 음행을 위해 있지 않고 주님을 위해 있으며, 주님께서는 몸을 위해 계십니다.
ko.R: 그러나 몸은 성적인 죄를 짓기 위해 있는 것이 아닙니다. 몸은 주님을 위해 있습니다. 그리고 주님께서는 몸을 소중히 여기십니다.

decisions.choice: the body is not like the stomach: it is the whole person in bodily life, and it belongs to the Lord
decisions.reason: Paul answers the saying in its own form. σῶμα is not one organ among others but the self as it lives and acts in the world, and it belongs to the Lord who will raise it (verse 14).

decisions.choice: sexual immorality: any sexual relationship outside marriage, here above all with prostitutes
decisions.reason: πορνείᾳ covers every kind of sexual sin (5:1); verses 15-16 show that sex with prostitutes is in view.

decisions.choice: the Lord for the body: the Lord is committed to the body and has a purpose for it
decisions.reason: The Lord does not treat the body as worthless; he claims it and will raise it from death (verse 14; 15:42-44).

decisions.choice: does not exist for ... it exists for
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the same verb as in the saying ("Food exists for the stomach") so the reader hears Paul answering it.

decisions.choice: the Lord cares about the body
decisions.reason: Readable gives a verb for the short Greek phrase (m3).

decisions.choice: n’est pas fait pour ... il est fait pour (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the same verb as in the saying ("La nourriture est faite pour le ventre"), as the English repeats "exists for", so the reader hears Paul answering it; "être fait pour" is the natural French for purpose.

source.text: ὁ δὲ θεὸς καὶ τὸν κύριον ἤγειρεν καὶ ἡμᾶς ἐξεγερεῖ διὰ τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: But God both the Lord raised and us will raise up through the power of him.

en.L: And God both raised the Lord and will raise us up through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power.
en.B: God raised the Lord, and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will raise us as well.
en.R: God raised the Lord Jesus from death, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will use {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power to raise us too.

fr.L: Et Dieu a ressuscité le Seigneur, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous ressuscitera aussi par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance.
fr.B: Dieu a ressuscité le Seigneur, et par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous ressuscitera, nous aussi.
fr.R: Dieu a ramené le Seigneur Jésus de la mort à la vie, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} utilisera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance pour nous ramener à la vie, nous aussi.

es.L: Y Dios resucitó al Señor y también nos levantará a nosotros por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder.
es.B: Dios resucitó al Señor, y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder nos resucitará también a nosotros.
es.R: Dios resucitó al Señor Jesús de entre los muertos, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} usará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder para resucitarnos también a nosotros.

sw.L: Naye Mungu alimfufua Bwana, na sisi pia atatufufua kupitia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Mungu alimfufua Bwana, na kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} atatufufua sisi pia.
sw.R: Mungu alimfufua Bwana Yesu kutoka kwa wafu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kutufufua sisi pia.

vi.L: Và Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến Chúa sống lại, và cũng sẽ khiến chúng ta sống lại bởi quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến Chúa sống lại, và bởi quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng sẽ khiến chúng ta sống lại.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến Chúa Giê-xu sống lại từ cõi chết, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ dùng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để khiến chúng ta cũng sống lại.

ko.L: 하나님께서는 주님을 살리셨고, 그분의 능력으로 우리도 살리실 것입니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 주님을 살리셨고, 그분의 능력으로 우리도 살리실 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 주 예수를 죽음에서 다시 살리셨습니다. 그리고 그분의 능력으로 우리도 다시 살리실 것입니다.

decisions.choice: Paul's answer to "God will do away with both": God will not do away with the body but raise it
decisions.reason: ὁ δὲ θεὸς matches the end of the saying in verse 13. What God does with the body is resurrection, not destruction, so the body matters now.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "will raise"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts have the present or the past tense instead of the future. The future fits the contrast with Christ's resurrection, already past. Reviewers should check the manuscript evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: his power: God's power
decisions.reason: αὐτοῦ refers back to God, the subject of the sentence.

decisions.choice: the Lord Jesus from death
decisions.reason: Readable names the Lord and says what he was raised from.

decisions.choice: ramener de la mort à la vie (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says in plain words what "ressusciter" means, as the English Readable adds "from death". Literal and Balanced keep "ressusciter" for the resurrection words of the letter.

decisions.choice: "khiến ... sống lại" for egeiro with God as subject (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Sống lại" is the plain Protestant word for rising from the dead; where God is named as the one who acts, the verb takes "khiến" (cause). "Phục sinh" is the Sino-Vietnamese word used more by Catholics.

decisions.choice: "살리다" for God raising the dead at every level, "다시 살리다" (R), through the letter
decisions.reason: "살리다" (make alive) is the word of Galatians 1:1 and Romans for God raising Jesus; "일으키다" (raise up) is not used in Korean for the dead.

source.text: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι τὰ σώματα ὑμῶν μέλη Χριστοῦ ἐστιν;

records.literal_gloss: Not do you know that the bodies of you members of Christ are?

en.L: Do you not know that your bodies are members of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}?
en.B: Do you not know that your bodies are parts of {{christos:Christ's|the Messiah's}} body?
en.R: Do you not know that your bodies belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} as parts of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own body?

fr.L: Ne savez-vous pas que vos corps sont des membres du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ?
fr.B: Ne savez-vous pas que vos corps sont des membres du corps du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ?
fr.R: Ne savez-vous pas que vos corps appartiennent au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, comme les parties de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre corps ?

es.L: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos son miembros de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}?
es.B: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos son partes del cuerpo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}?
es.R: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos pertenecen {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} como partes de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio cuerpo?

sw.L: Je, hamfahamu kwamba miili yenu ni viungo vya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}?
sw.B: Je, hamjui kwamba miili yenu ni sehemu za mwili wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}?
sw.R: Je, hamjui kwamba miili yenu ni mali ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, kama sehemu za mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe?

vi.L: Anh chị em không biết rằng thân thể anh chị em là chi thể của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sao?
vi.B: Anh chị em không biết rằng thân thể anh chị em là những bộ phận của thân thể {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sao?
vi.R: Anh chị em không biết rằng thân thể anh chị em thuộc về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là những bộ phận của chính thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao?

ko.L: 여러분의 몸이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 지체라는 것을 알지 못합니까?
ko.B: 여러분의 몸이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 몸의 부분이라는 것을 알지 못합니까?
ko.R: 여러분의 몸이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 몸의 한 부분으로서 그분께 속해 있다는 것을 알지 못합니까?

decisions.choice: members: limbs and organs, the parts of a body
decisions.reason: μέλη are the parts of a body, as in 12:12-27. The believer's body is joined to Christ as a hand or foot is joined to a body.

decisions.choice: the believer's own physical body is joined to Christ
alternatives: only the church as a whole is Christ's body
decisions.reason: Here Paul speaks of their bodies, plural: what each person does with the body is done with something that belongs to Christ.

decisions.choice: parts of Christ's body (B); belong to Christ as parts of his own body (R)
decisions.reason: "Members" now usually means members of a club; Balanced and Readable keep the picture of a body (m1).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ's|the Messiah's}} (B); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: membres (L, B); parties (R)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced says "parts" because "members" now suggests a club. French "les membres" still names the limbs of a body in everyday speech, so Balanced keeps it, adding "du corps" to make the picture plain (m1). Readable says "parties". The article is outside the christos span, as in chapter 5.

decisions.choice: viungo (L); sehemu za mwili (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Literal keeps "viungo" (members, limbs), and Balanced and Readable say "sehemu za mwili" (parts of the body), the words chapter 12 will use.

decisions.choice: "chi thể" (L); "bộ phận" (B, R) for mele (also 6:15b and chapter 12)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Romans 12:4: "chi thể" is the church word for a member of a body, "bộ phận" the everyday word for a part.

decisions.choice: "지체" (L); "부분" (B, R) for the members, here and in chapter 12
decisions.reason: As in Romans 12:4: "지체" is the church word for a part of a body, and Balanced and Readable say the plain "부분", as the English says "parts".

source.text: ἄρας οὖν τὰ μέλη τοῦ Χριστοῦ ποιήσω πόρνης μέλη;

records.literal_gloss: Taking away then the members of the Christ shall I make of a prostitute members?

en.L: Taking, then, the members of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, shall I make [them] members of a prostitute?
en.B: Am I then to take parts of {{christos:Christ's|the Messiah's}} body and make them parts of a prostitute's body?
en.R: So should I take parts of {{christos:Christ's|the Messiah's}} body and join them to a prostitute?

fr.L: Prenant donc les membres du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, en ferai-je des membres d’une prostituée ?
fr.B: Vais-je donc prendre les membres du corps du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} pour en faire les membres du corps d’une prostituée ?
fr.R: Est-ce que je vais prendre des parties du corps du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et les unir à une prostituée ?

es.L: ¿Tomaré, pues, los miembros del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} y [los] haré miembros de una prostituta?
es.B: ¿Voy a tomar entonces partes del cuerpo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} para hacerlas partes del cuerpo de una prostituta?
es.R: ¿Entonces debo tomar partes del cuerpo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} y unirlas a una prostituta?

sw.L: Basi, nikiviondoa viungo vya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, je, nivifanye kuwa viungo vya kahaba?
sw.B: Je, basi nichukue sehemu za mwili wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na kuzifanya sehemu za mwili wa kahaba?
sw.R: Basi je, nichukue sehemu za mwili wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na kuziunganisha na kahaba?

vi.L: Vậy tôi có nên lấy các chi thể của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} mà làm chi thể của một kỵ nữ sao?
vi.B: Vậy tôi có nên lấy những bộ phận của thân thể {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} để làm bộ phận của thân thể một gái mại dâm sao?
vi.R: Vậy tôi có nên lấy những bộ phận của thân thể {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} mà kết hợp với một gái mại dâm không?

ko.L: 그렇다면 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 지체를 떼어서 창녀의 지체로 만들겠습니까?
ko.B: 그렇다면 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 몸의 부분을 떼어다가 창녀의 몸의 부분으로 만들어야 하겠습니까?
ko.R: 그러면 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 몸의 부분을 떼어다가 창녀와 하나로 묶어야 하겠습니까?

decisions.choice: I: Paul uses himself as the example
decisions.reason: ποιήσω is first person. Paul puts the question to himself to show how unthinkable it is for any believer.

decisions.choice: taking away: removing the members from Christ
decisions.reason: ἄρας can mean to take up or to take away. Joining one's body to a prostitute is pictured as taking it away from Christ.

decisions.choice: a prostitute: a woman who sold sex, a common part of life in Greek and Roman cities
decisions.reason: Prostitution was legal and widespread, and many men saw visits to prostitutes, often after banquets, as normal. Some of the Corinthian believers seem to have kept to this custom.

decisions.choice: parts of Christ's body (B, R); parts of a prostitute's body (B); join them to a prostitute (R)
decisions.reason: As in 15.s1.

decisions.choice: "kỵ nữ" (L); "gái mại dâm" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Kỵ nữ" is the older word for a prostitute, which keeps Literal close to the Greek; Balanced and Readable use the plain modern word. "Dâm phụ" means an immoral woman in general.

decisions.choice: "창녀" for the prostitute at every level
decisions.reason: "창녀" is the plain word of the Gospels (Matthew 21:31) for a prostitute.

source.text: μὴ γένοιτο.

records.literal_gloss: Not may it be.

en.L: May it not be!
en.B: Absolutely not!
en.R: No, never!

fr.L: Que cela ne soit pas !
fr.B: Certainement pas !
fr.R: Non, jamais !

es.L: ¡Que no sea así!
es.B: ¡De ninguna manera!
es.R: ¡No, nunca!

sw.L: Isiwe hivyo!
sw.B: Hasha!
sw.R: Sivyo kabisa!

vi.L: Không hề như vậy!
vi.B: Chẳng hề như vậy!
vi.R: Không đời nào!

ko.L: 결코 그럴 수 없습니다!
ko.B: 절대로 그렇지 않습니다!
ko.R: 절대 아닙니다!

decisions.choice: the strongest possible rejection
decisions.reason: μὴ γένοιτο is Paul's way of rejecting a thought with horror (Romans 6:2, 15; Galatians 2:17).

decisions.choice: Absolutely not (B); No, never (R)
decisions.reason: "God forbid" adds God's name, which the Greek does not have.

decisions.choice: Isiwe hivyo! (L); Hasha! (B); Sivyo kabisa! (R)
decisions.reason: The forms Swahili Romans uses for the same strong rejection (Romans 6:2).

decisions.choice: "Không hề như vậy!" (L); "Chẳng hề như vậy!" (B); "Không đời nào!" (R) for me genoito
decisions.reason: The forms of the Vietnamese Romans and Galatians.

decisions.choice: "결코 그럴 수 없습니다!" (L); "절대로 그렇지 않습니다!" (B); "절대 아닙니다!" (R)
decisions.reason: The words Romans uses for the same Greek phrase (Romans 3:4; 6:2).

source.text: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ὁ κολλώμενος τῇ πόρνῃ ἓν σῶμά ἐστιν;

records.literal_gloss: Or not do you know that the [one] joining himself to the prostitute one body is?

en.L: Or do you not know that the one who joins himself to the prostitute is one body [with her]?
en.B: Or do you not know that a man who attaches himself to a prostitute forms one body with her?
en.R: Do you not know that a man who has sex with a prostitute becomes one body with her?

fr.L: Ou ne savez-vous pas que celui qui s’attache à la prostituée est un seul corps [avec elle] ?
fr.B: Ou ne savez-vous pas que l’homme qui s’unit à une prostituée forme un seul corps avec elle ?
fr.R: Ne savez-vous pas qu’un homme qui a des relations sexuelles avec une prostituée devient un seul corps avec elle ?

es.L: ¿O no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que el que se une a la prostituta es un cuerpo [con ella]?
es.B: ¿O no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que el hombre que se une a una prostituta forma un solo cuerpo con ella?
es.R: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que un hombre que tiene relaciones sexuales con una prostituta se hace un solo cuerpo con ella?

sw.L: Au hamjui kwamba anayejiunga na kahaba ni mwili mmoja [naye]?
sw.B: Au hamjui kwamba mwanamume anayejiunga na kahaba anakuwa mwili mmoja naye?
sw.R: Je, hamjui kwamba mwanamume anayefanya ngono na kahaba anakuwa mwili mmoja naye?

vi.L: Hay anh chị em không biết rằng người kết hợp với kỵ nữ là một thân thể [với người ấy] sao?
vi.B: Hay anh chị em không biết rằng một người đàn ông kết hợp với gái mại dâm thì trở nên một thân thể với cô ta sao?
vi.R: Anh chị em không biết rằng một người đàn ông quan hệ tình dục với gái mại dâm thì trở nên một thân thể với cô ta sao?

ko.L: 아니면 창녀와 결합하는 사람은 [그 여자와] 한 몸이라는 것을 알지 못합니까?
ko.B: 아니면 창녀와 결합하는 남자는 그 여자와 한 몸이 된다는 것을 알지 못합니까?
ko.R: 창녀와 성관계를 하는 남자는 그 여자와 한 몸이 된다는 것을 알지 못합니까?

decisions.choice: joins himself: is closely united, here in sexual union
decisions.reason: κολλώμενος means to stick to or cling to. The Greek of Genesis 2:24 uses the same verb for a man clinging to his wife, and verse 17 uses it of being joined to the Lord.

decisions.choice: the man who visits a prostitute
decisions.reason: The participle is masculine, and in this setting it means men who went to prostitutes (m3 in 15.s2).

decisions.choice: one body: sexual union makes a real bond between two people, not a passing act
decisions.reason: Paul takes sex to unite two persons, as Genesis says of marriage. What the body does involves the whole person.

decisions.choice: [with her] (L); with her (B, R)
decisions.reason: English needs to say with whom he is one body.

decisions.choice: "결합하다" (L, B) for the verb of verses 16-17, "성관계를 하다" (R) here
decisions.reason: Genesis 2:24, quoted next, uses the same verb for a man clinging to his wife; "결합하다" is the word of Ephesians 5:31 (L) for that verse, and verse 17 keeps it for being joined to the Lord.

source.text: Ἔσονται γάρ, φησίν, οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.

records.literal_gloss: Will be for, he says, the two into flesh one.

en.L: For, it says, "The two will be one flesh."
en.B: For Scripture says, "The two will be united into one flesh."
en.R: As Scripture says, "The two will become one body."

fr.L: Car, est-il dit, « les deux seront une seule chair ».
fr.B: Car l’Écriture dit : « Les deux seront unis en une seule chair. »
fr.R: Comme le dit l’Écriture : « Les deux deviendront un seul corps. »

es.L: Porque, dice, «los dos serán una sola carne».
es.B: Porque la Escritura dice: «Los dos se unirán en una sola carne».
es.R: Como dice la Escritura: «Los dos llegarán a ser un solo cuerpo».

sw.L: Kwa maana inasema, "Hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja."
sw.B: Kwa maana Maandiko yanasema, "Hao wawili wataunganika kuwa mwili mmoja."
sw.R: Kama Maandiko yanavyosema, "Hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja."

vi.L: Vì, có lời phán: "Hai người sẽ trở nên một thịt."
vi.B: Vì Kinh Thánh có chép: "Hai người sẽ hợp lại thành một thịt."
vi.R: Như Kinh Thánh nói: "Hai người sẽ trở nên một thân."

ko.L: "그 둘이 한 육체가 될 것이다" 하고 말하기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 성경에 "그 둘은 하나가 되어 한 몸이 될 것이다" 하였기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 성경은 이렇게 말합니다. "그 둘은 한 몸이 될 것이다."

decisions.choice: a quotation of Genesis 2:24
decisions.reason: The words are from Genesis 2:24, where a man leaves his parents and clings to his wife. The Greek Old Testament has "the two", which the Hebrew text does not have; Jesus quotes the verse in the same form (Matthew 19:5; Mark 10:8). Reviewers should check the wording against the Greek Old Testament.

decisions.choice: it says: Scripture says
decisions.reason: φησίν has no stated subject. It can mean "it says", the usual way of introducing Scripture, or "he says", meaning God, as Jesus treats this verse as the Creator's word (Matthew 19:4-5). Either way the words carry God's authority.

decisions.choice: become one flesh: become a single unit of life, as in marriage
decisions.reason: εἰς σάρκα μίαν follows a Hebrew way of saying "become one flesh". In Genesis it describes the union of husband and wife. Paul applies it to the union with a prostitute: even that act makes a bond of the kind God made for marriage.

decisions.choice: Scripture says
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "it" is (m2).

decisions.choice: one flesh (L, B); one body (R)
decisions.reason: In this quotation "flesh" means a human being in bodily life, not "merely human", so Literal and Balanced keep the familiar words of Genesis. Readable says "one body", which links the verse with the first half of verse 16.

decisions.choice: united into
decisions.reason: The Greek "will be into" means "will become"; Balanced gives it a full English verb.

decisions.choice: mwili mmoja
alternatives: mwili mmoja (flesh) and a different word for body
decisions.reason: Swahili "mwili" means both flesh and body, so Readable needs no change from the other levels where the English Readable says "one body", and the quotation answers verse 16a in the same word.

decisions.choice: "trở nên một thịt" (L, B); "trở nên một thân" (R)
decisions.reason: "Trở nên một thịt" is the wording of the Vietnamese Ephesians 5:31, which quotes the same verse of Genesis; Readable says "one body", as the English does.

decisions.choice: the words of Genesis 2:24 as in Ephesians 5:31: "한 육체" (L); "한 몸" (B, R), in the plain style
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the verse that Ephesians 5:31 quotes, so Korean keeps the same words. Literal keeps "flesh", as the English does.

source.text: ὁ δὲ κολλώμενος τῷ κυρίῳ ἓν πνεῦμά ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: But the [one] joining himself to the Lord one spirit is.

en.L: But the one who is joined to the Lord is one spirit [with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}].
en.B: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one spirit with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in spirit.

fr.L: Mais celui qui s’attache au Seigneur est un seul esprit [avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}].
fr.B: Mais celui qui s’unit au Seigneur ne fait avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qu’un seul esprit.
fr.R: Mais celui qui est uni au Seigneur ne fait qu’un avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} en esprit.

es.L: Pero el que se une al Señor es un espíritu [con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}].
es.B: Pero el que se une al Señor es un solo espíritu con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Pero todo el que está unido al Señor es uno con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en espíritu.

sw.L: Lakini anayejiunga na Bwana ni roho moja [{{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}].
sw.B: Lakini yeyote anayejiunga na Bwana ni roho moja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.R: Lakini mtu yeyote aliyeunganishwa na Bwana ni mmoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} katika roho.

vi.L: Nhưng người kết hợp với Chúa thì là một linh [với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}].
vi.B: Nhưng ai kết hợp với Chúa thì là một tâm linh với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng ai kết hợp với Chúa thì được hiệp một với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong tâm linh.

ko.L: 그러나 주님과 결합하는 사람은 [그분과] 한 영입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 주님과 결합하는 사람은 그분과 한 영이 됩니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주님과 결합한 사람은 영으로 그분과 하나가 됩니다.

decisions.choice: the same verb as in verse 16, set in contrast; here it means any believer
decisions.reason: κολλώμενος repeats the word used of the man and the prostitute. The masculine form here is general: anyone, man or woman, who belongs to the Lord.

decisions.choice: one spirit: united with the Lord through the Holy Spirit
alternatives: united only in the human spirit, apart from the body
decisions.reason: Union with the Lord is made by the Spirit (12:13), and verse 19 says the Spirit lives in the believer's body. This is not a spiritual union that leaves the body out: verse 15 has already said the body is joined to Christ.

decisions.choice: the believer's union with the Lord rules out union with a prostitute
decisions.reason: The two unions cannot be held together: the one joined to the Lord cannot also join the Lord's members to a prostitute (verse 15).

decisions.choice: [with him] (L); with him (B, R)
decisions.reason: English needs to say with whom the believer is one.

decisions.choice: s’attache (L), s’unit (B), as in verse 16
decisions.reason: The same French verb is used for the man and the prostitute in verse 16 and for the believer and the Lord here, so that the contrast Paul draws with one verb stays visible (m1).

decisions.choice: anayejiunga
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 16 ("anayejiunga na kahaba"), so the contrast the meaning decision describes stays visible.

source.text: φεύγετε τὴν πορνείαν· πᾶν ἁμάρτημα ὃ ἐὰν ποιήσῃ ἄνθρωπος ἐκτὸς τοῦ σώματός ἐστιν, ὁ δὲ πορνεύων εἰς τὸ ἴδιον σῶμα ἁμαρτάνει.

records.literal_gloss: Flee the sexual immorality; every sin which if does a person outside the body is, but the [one] committing sexual immorality into the own body sins.

en.L: Flee sexual immorality. Every sin that a {{gender:person|man}} commits is outside the body, but the one who commits sexual immorality sins against [{{gender:their|his}}] own body.
en.B: Get away from sexual immorality! Whatever other sin someone commits stays outside the body, but the one who is sexually immoral sins against {{gender:their|his}} very own body.
en.R: Run away from sexual sin! No other sin touches the body the way it does. People who commit sexual sin are sinning against their own bodies.

fr.L: Fuyez l’immoralité sexuelle. Tout péché que commet un {{gender:être humain|homme}} est extérieur au corps, mais celui qui commet l’immoralité sexuelle pèche contre son propre corps.
fr.B: Fuyez l’immoralité sexuelle ! Tout autre péché que l’on commet reste extérieur au corps, mais celui qui vit dans l’immoralité sexuelle pèche contre son propre corps.
fr.R: Fuyez le péché sexuel ! Aucun autre péché ne touche le corps comme lui. Ceux qui commettent des péchés sexuels pèchent contre leur propre corps.

es.L: {{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}} de la inmoralidad sexual. Todo pecado que {{gender:una persona|un hombre}} cometa está fuera del cuerpo, pero el que comete inmoralidad sexual peca contra [su] propio cuerpo.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Apártense|Apartaos}} de la inmoralidad sexual! Cualquier otro pecado que alguien cometa queda fuera del cuerpo, pero el que es sexualmente inmoral peca contra su propio cuerpo.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}} del pecado sexual! Ningún otro pecado afecta al cuerpo como ese. Los que cometen pecado sexual pecan contra su propio cuerpo.

sw.L: Ukimbieni uasherati. Kila dhambi ambayo mtu anaitenda iko nje ya mwili, lakini anayefanya uasherati anatenda dhambi dhidi ya mwili wake mwenyewe.
sw.B: Kaeni mbali na uasherati! Dhambi nyingine yoyote ambayo mtu anatenda inabaki nje ya mwili, lakini mwasherati anatenda dhambi dhidi ya mwili wake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Ikimbieni dhambi ya ngono! Hakuna dhambi nyingine inayougusa mwili kama dhambi hiyo. Watu wanaofanya dhambi ya ngono wanatenda dhambi dhidi ya miili yao wenyewe.

vi.L: Hãy tránh xa sự tà dâm. Mọi tội mà một người phạm đều ở bên ngoài thân thể, nhưng người phạm tội tà dâm thì phạm tội nghịch cùng chính thân thể mình.
vi.B: Hãy chạy trốn khỏi sự tà dâm! Mọi tội khác mà người ta phạm đều ở bên ngoài thân thể, nhưng người tà dâm thì phạm tội nghịch cùng chính thân thể của mình.
vi.R: Hãy chạy thật xa khỏi tội tình dục! Không có tội nào khác ảnh hưởng đến thân thể như tội ấy. Những người phạm tội tình dục là đang phạm tội nghịch cùng chính thân thể mình.

ko.L: 음행을 피하십시오. 사람이 짓는 모든 죄는 몸 밖에 있지만, 음행하는 사람은 자기 몸에 죄를 짓습니다.
ko.B: 음행을 멀리하고 피하십시오! 사람이 짓는 다른 죄는 다 몸 밖에 있지만, 음행하는 사람은 바로 자기 몸에 죄를 짓는 것입니다.
ko.R: 성적인 죄에서 도망치십시오! 다른 어떤 죄도 성적인 죄처럼 몸에 해를 주지 않습니다. 성적인 죄를 짓는 사람은 자기 몸에 죄를 짓는 것입니다.

decisions.choice: flee: keep running from it, a continuing command
decisions.reason: φεύγετε is a present imperative: make a habit of getting away. Joseph's flight from Potiphar's wife (Genesis 39:12) is the classic picture of such a flight.

decisions.choice: Paul's own words: no other sin involves the body as sexual sin does
alternatives: another Corinthian saying, "every sin a person commits is outside the body", which Paul answers with "but"
decisions.reason: The Greek has no quotation marks. Some read the middle clause as a saying like those in verses 12-13, claiming that what the body does cannot touch the self, and Paul's reply as following it. Read as Paul's own words, the clause is a comparison rather than an absolute: other sins harm the body too, but sexual sin is done with the body against the body, joining it to another.

decisions.choice: against one's own body: a sin against the body that belongs to the Lord
decisions.reason: εἰς here means "against". The body is joined to the Lord (verse 15) and is the Spirit's temple (verse 19), so sexual sin wrongs one's own body in a unique way.

decisions.choice: a person: anyone, man or woman
decisions.reason: ἄνθρωπος is general.

decisions.choice: other (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "other" to show that sexual sin is being set apart from every other sin (m2). Readable states the comparison plainly.

decisions.choice: {{gender:person|man}} (L); {{gender:their|his}} (L, B)
decisions.reason: The person meant is anyone, man or woman (m4). Readable uses the plural, which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: {{gender:être humain|homme}} (L); "l’on" (B); "son propre corps" without a span (L, B)
decisions.reason: The noun for a person takes the gender setting at Literal (m4). Balanced says "l’on", which is already generic. The English needs a span for "their/his", but the French possessive "son" does not mark gender, so it takes none.

decisions.choice: {{gender:una persona|un hombre}} (L); su, no span (L, B)
decisions.reason: Spanish follows the English setting for the noun. Spanish "su" means his or her, so the possessive needs no span, unlike the English "{{gender:their|his}}".

source.text: ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι τὸ σῶμα ὑμῶν ναὸς τοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν ἁγίου πνεύματός ἐστιν, οὗ ἔχετε ἀπὸ θεοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: Or not do you know that the body of you temple of the in you Holy Spirit is, whom you have from God?

en.L: Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit [who is] in you, [the Spirit] whom you have from God?
en.B: Or do you not know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives, the Spirit who is in you and whom God has given you?
en.R: Do you not know that your body is a temple, a home for the Holy Spirit? The Spirit lives in you, and God is the one who gave you the Spirit.

fr.L: Ou ne savez-vous pas que votre corps est un temple de l’Esprit Saint [qui est] en vous, [l’Esprit] que vous tenez de Dieu ?
fr.B: Ou ne savez-vous pas que votre corps est un temple où habite l’Esprit Saint, l’Esprit qui est en vous et que Dieu vous a donné ?
fr.R: Ne savez-vous pas que votre corps est un temple, une maison pour l’Esprit Saint ? L’Esprit habite en vous, et c’est Dieu qui vous a donné l’Esprit.

es.L: ¿O no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo es templo del Espíritu Santo [que está] en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, el cual {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} de Dios?
es.B: ¿O no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo es un templo donde vive el Espíritu Santo, el Espíritu que está en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado?
es.R: ¿No {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo es un templo, una casa para el Espíritu Santo? El Espíritu vive en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y Dios es quien {{plural_you:les|os}} dio el Espíritu.

sw.L: Au hamjui kwamba mwili wenu ni hekalu la Roho Mtakatifu [anayekaa] ndani yenu, ambaye mnaye kutoka kwa Mungu?
sw.B: Au hamjui kwamba mwili wenu ni hekalu ambamo Roho Mtakatifu anaishi, Roho aliye ndani yenu, ambaye Mungu amewapa?
sw.R: Je, hamjui kwamba mwili wenu ni hekalu, makao ya Roho Mtakatifu? Roho anaishi ndani yenu, na Mungu ndiye aliyewapa Roho huyo.

vi.L: Hay anh chị em không biết rằng thân thể anh chị em là đền thờ của Đức Thánh Linh [là Đấng] ở trong anh chị em, [Đấng] mà anh chị em đã nhận từ Đức Chúa Trời sao?
vi.B: Hay anh chị em không biết rằng thân thể anh chị em là đền thờ, nơi Đức Thánh Linh ngự, là Đấng ở trong anh chị em, Đấng mà Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho anh chị em sao?
vi.R: Anh chị em không biết rằng thân thể anh chị em là một đền thờ, là nhà của Đức Thánh Linh sao? Thánh Linh ngự trong anh chị em, và chính Đức Chúa Trời đã ban Thánh Linh cho anh chị em.

ko.L: 아니면 여러분의 몸은 여러분 안에 계신 성령의 성전이며, 여러분이 하나님에게서 받은 [성령]의 [성전]이라는 것을 알지 못합니까?
ko.B: 아니면 여러분의 몸은 성령께서 사시는 성전이라는 것을 알지 못합니까? 성령께서는 여러분 안에 계시고, 여러분은 그분을 하나님께로부터 받았습니다.
ko.R: 여러분의 몸은 성전, 곧 성령께서 사시는 집이라는 것을 알지 못합니까? 성령께서는 여러분 안에 사십니다. 하나님께서 여러분에게 성령을 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: temple: the sanctuary itself, the house where God lives
decisions.reason: As in 3:16, ναὸς is the inner house of a temple, where the deity was thought to be present.

decisions.choice: each believer's body is a temple of the Spirit
alternatives: the church as a whole is the body that is the temple, as in 3:16
decisions.reason: "Your" is plural but σῶμα is singular. In 3:16 the church is God's temple; here, after verses 15-18 on what each person does with the body, Paul applies the picture to each believer's body, while still addressing them all together.

decisions.choice: whom you have from God: the Spirit is God's gift
decisions.reason: The relative οὗ refers to the Spirit. The Spirit is not something they own by nature; God has given the Spirit to them, so the body that houses the Spirit is not theirs to use as they like (verse 19b).

decisions.choice: a temple where the Holy Spirit lives (B); a home for the Holy Spirit (R)
alternatives: a temple of the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what makes the body a temple: the Spirit lives in it.

decisions.choice: "Đức Thánh Linh" for "the Holy Spirit", with "Đấng" for the relative
decisions.reason: The style guide's name where the Greek says "Holy Spirit". The relative is "Đấng", a person, never "điều" or "nó", as the book-wide choice requires (also 12:11).

source.text: καὶ οὐκ ἐστὲ ἑαυτῶν, ἠγοράσθητε γὰρ τιμῆς· δοξάσατε δὴ τὸν θεὸν ἐν τῷ σώματι ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And not you are of yourselves, \v 20 you were bought for at a price; glorify then the God in the body of you.

en.L: And you do not belong to yourselves; \v 20 for you were bought for a price. Glorify God, then, in your body.
en.B: You do not belong to yourselves. \v 20 You were bought, and a price was paid for you. So bring glory to God in your body.
en.R: You do not belong to yourselves anymore. \v 20 God bought you and paid the price for you. So use your body to bring glory to God.

fr.L: Et vous n’êtes pas à vous-mêmes, \v 20 car vous avez été achetés à un prix. Glorifiez donc Dieu dans votre corps.
fr.B: Vous ne vous appartenez pas. \v 20 Vous avez été achetés, et un prix a été payé pour vous. Rendez donc gloire à Dieu dans votre corps.
fr.R: Vous ne vous appartenez plus. \v 20 Dieu vous a achetés, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a payé le prix pour vous. Alors servez-vous de votre corps pour rendre gloire à Dieu.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:son|sois}} de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos, \v 20 porque {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} comprados por un precio. {{plural_you:Glorifiquen|Glorificad}}, pues, a Dios en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo.
es.B: No {{plural_you:se pertenecen|os pertenecéis}} a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos. \v 20 {{plural_you:Fueron|Fuisteis}} comprados, y se pagó un precio por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Así que {{plural_you:den|dad}} gloria a Dios en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo.
es.R: Ya no {{plural_you:se pertenecen|os pertenecéis}} a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos. \v 20 Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} compró y pagó el precio por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Así que {{plural_you:usen|usad}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo para dar gloria a Dios.

sw.L: Wala hamjimiliki ninyi wenyewe; \v 20 kwa maana mlinunuliwa kwa gharama. Basi, katika mwili wenu mtukuzeni Mungu.
sw.B: Ninyi si wenu wenyewe. \v 20 Mlinunuliwa, na gharama ililipwa kwa ajili yenu. Kwa hiyo mleteeni Mungu utukufu katika mwili wenu.
sw.R: Ninyi si mali yenu wenyewe tena. \v 20 Mungu aliwanunua na kulipa gharama kwa ajili yenu. Kwa hiyo tumieni mwili wenu kumletea Mungu utukufu.

vi.L: Và anh chị em không thuộc về chính mình; \v 20 vì anh chị em đã được mua bằng một giá. Vậy, hãy tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời trong thân thể anh chị em.
vi.B: Anh chị em không thuộc về chính mình. \v 20 Anh chị em đã được mua, và một giá đã được trả cho anh chị em. Vậy, hãy đem vinh quang về cho Đức Chúa Trời trong thân thể anh chị em.
vi.R: Anh chị em không còn thuộc về chính mình nữa. \v 20 Đức Chúa Trời đã mua anh chị em và đã trả giá cho anh chị em. Vậy hãy dùng thân thể mình để đem vinh quang về cho Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 여러분은 여러분 자신의 것이 아닙니다. \v 20 여러분은 값으로 산 사람들이기 때문입니다. 그러므로 여러분의 몸으로 하나님을 영화롭게 하십시오.
ko.B: 여러분은 여러분 자신의 것이 아닙니다. \v 20 하나님께서 값을 치르고 여러분을 사셨습니다. 그러므로 여러분의 몸으로 하나님께 영광을 돌리십시오.
ko.R: 여러분은 이제 여러분 자신의 것이 아닙니다. \v 20 하나님께서 여러분을 사셨고, 그 값을 치르셨습니다. 그러니 여러분의 몸을 사용해 하나님께 영광을 돌리십시오.

decisions.choice: bought: as a slave is bought, so that the believer now belongs to a new master
alternatives: set free by a purchase, as when a slave was freed
decisions.reason: ἠγοράσθητε is the ordinary word for buying, and buying people meant the slave market. In 7:22-23 Paul uses the same picture: "you were bought at a price; do not become slaves of people." The point here is ownership: they belong to God.

decisions.choice: a price: a real cost was paid, the death of Christ
decisions.reason: τιμῆς is a genitive of price: "at a price". Paul does not name the price here, but elsewhere he speaks of Christ's death as the cost of redemption (Galatians 3:13; compare 1 Peter 1:18-19).

decisions.choice: glorify: honor God and show his worth by what one does
decisions.reason: δοξάσατε is a command: with the body that belongs to God, do what brings him honor. The body itself is the place where God is honored, not something to be set aside.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: the sentence ends with "in your body"
alternatives: many later manuscripts add "and in your spirit, which are God's"
decisions.reason: The longer ending is found in many later manuscripts and in the King James Version, but not in the oldest manuscripts, which the SBLGNT follows. Reviewers should check the manuscript evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: for ... then: the purchase is the reason they are not their own, and the command follows from it
decisions.reason: γὰρ gives the reason for verse 19b, and δὴ draws the conclusion with force.

decisions.choice: glorify (L); bring glory to (B, R)
decisions.reason: Key term: the verb stays with the word "glory" at every level.

decisions.choice: a price was paid for you (B); God bought you and paid the price for you (R)
alternatives: you were bought at a price
decisions.reason: Balanced makes the genitive of price a clause; Readable names God as the buyer, which the passive implies (m1, m2), and adds "anymore" in verse 19 to show the change of owner.

decisions.choice: glorifiquen (L); den gloria (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb built on "gloria"; Balanced and Readable say "dar gloria", as Romans 4:20 does, so the key term "gloria" is heard at every level.

decisions.choice: mlinunuliwa kwa gharama (L); mlinunuliwa, na gharama ililipwa (B); Mungu aliwanunua na kulipa gharama (R)
decisions.reason: "Gharama" is the cost actually paid, which the meaning decision stresses (the death of Christ); "thamani" is rather worth or value. The same words are to be used in 7:23.

decisions.choice: "được mua bằng một giá" (L); "được mua, và một giá đã được trả cho anh chị em" (B); "Đức Chúa Trời đã mua anh chị em và đã trả giá" (R) (also 7:23)
decisions.reason: The levels follow the book-wide English choice. "Mua" keeps the picture of a slave bought by a new master (m1); "chuộc" would name redemption, which the Greek verb here does not say.

decisions.choice: "값으로 산 사람들" (L); "하나님께서 값을 치르고 사셨습니다" (B); "하나님께서 ... 사셨고, 그 값을 치르셨습니다" (R), here and in 7:23
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes a slave bought at the market; Korean "사다" (buy) keeps that picture, and Balanced and Readable name God as the buyer, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "영화롭게 하다" (L); "영광을 돌리다" (B, R)
